prompts.prompt:
Cinematic emotional short film, live-action look, 16:9, 24 seconds, 24 fps. Characters: a ginger tabby cat that stands upright on its hind legs like a human, and a calico cat (black, white and orange). At the start the calico is zombie-like: cloudy pale eyes, torn fur hanging in shreds, sharp fangs. Opening setting: a dark rustic wooden cabin kitchen at night, pots on wooden shelves, a window with cold blue night light, wooden plank floor. Final setting: a green meadow at golden-hour sunset with white dandelion fluff floating in the air.

0:00-0:01.5 Extreme close-up of the ginger tabby with tears in his eyes, holding a black handgun with both paws, aimed toward the camera (gun out of focus in the foreground).

0:02-0:02.5 Over-the-shoulder wide shot from behind the ginger cat: he aims the handgun at the zombie calico slowly walking toward him across the wooden floor.

0:03-0:03.5 Front shot: the ginger cat stands upright, aiming with both paws, dark wooden wall and blue window behind him.

0:04-0:04.5 Close-up of the zombie calico, glassy pale eyes, then snarling with fangs.

0:05-0:06.5 Extreme close-up of the ginger cat's face, tears rolling down.

0:06.5-0:08 He stands aiming, then slowly lowers the gun.

0:08.5-0:09 The gun drops from his paw and he opens both arms wide for a hug.

0:09.5-0:10 Quick cuts: the zombie calico's face, then the ginger cat with eyes closed and a tear falling.

0:10.5 The calico leaps into his arms, wrapping her white paws around him; her fur is now healthy and normal.

0:11-0:13 Cut to the sunset meadow: the two cats roll and cuddle in the grass, white fluff floating around, warm golden light.

0:13-0:18 Close-up of the calico's affectionate face while the ginger cat's paw gently touches her face and head; the ginger cat lies on his back in the grass, eyes closed, peaceful.

0:18-0:20.5 The ginger cat's paw rests on her face; he looks up, content and relaxed.

0:21-0:22 Wide silhouette shot: the two cats sit snuggled together against the glowing sunset, tall grass and wildflowers in the foreground.

0:22.5-0:24 Close-up with sun flare: the ginger cat tenderly rubs his head against the calico's head. End.

Style: dramatic zombie-movie tension turning into a heartwarming ending, shallow depth of field, realistic fur detail, warm golden-hour light in the second half, dark low-key lighting in the first half.

Cinematic 2.5D animation in painterly rendering, gouache concept art in motion, visible brush textures, flat posterized color blocks, matte finish, soft volumetric lighting. NOT flat 2D cartoon, NO outlines, NOT glossy CGI, NO photorealism.  

WORLD: Shattered zero-G celestial observatory overlooking a collapsing golden planetary core, palette of obsidian black, ivory stone, and blinding gold energy, floating cosmic debris.  

CHARACTER: Extremely tall adult woman in early 20s, black visor-hat with glowing gold glyphs, floating orbital halo, black prosthetic arms with trailing strings. Massive ballooning obsidian cloak, cream draped gown, platform heels. Elongated tall proportions, supermodel legs, painterly matte skin.  

CINEMATIC SHOT DESIGN (10 Filmic Cuts across 30 Seconds): 
• SHOT 1 (0–3s | Macro Detail): Macro close-up of Ophelia's black prosthetic fingers twitching; glowing gold gravitational threads unspool into the vacuum. 
• SHOT 2 (3–6s | Scale & Threat): Wide shot of the dying planetary core cracking in half, blasting shockwaves of golden light through floating ivory pillars. 
• SHOT 3 (6–9s | Character Entrance): Low-angle tracking shot as Ophelia glides weightlessly into the abyss, her massive obsidian cloak ballooning around her like a cosmic void. 
• SHOT 4 (9–12s | Expression Focus): Close-up on her face under the visor; the gold glyphs flare brightly as she tilts her head in absolute, chilling composure. 
• SHOT 5 (12–15s | Casting the Strings): Medium shot; Ophelia sweeps both mechanical hands outward, casting hundreds of glowing gold puppet strings across the entire starfield. 
• SHOT 6 (15–18s | Reality Pull): Dynamic wide shot; she violently pulls the strings taut, arresting the collapse of the planet and dragging the colossal burning fragments back together. 
• SHOT 7 (18–21s | High-Speed Tracking): FPV tracking shot swooping past floating debris as the planetary fragments collide and fuse into a newly ignited miniature golden sun. 
• SHOT 8 (21–24s | Power Apex): Medium shot; Ophelia rotates her mechanical wrists, the floating orbital halo around her head spinning rapidly and locking the new star into orbit behind her. 
• SHOT 9 (24–27s | Aftermath Echo): Extreme wide shot; the restored golden star illuminates the massive expanse, Ophelia silhouetted dead-center as the master of the cosmos. 
• SHOT 10 (27–30s | Hero Poster Frame): Low-angle hero shot; Ophelia lowers her hands, gravity strings dissolving into gold dust, her massive black mantle settling around her towering silhouette. Hold final frame.  
Weighty natural animation, zero-G fabric motion, 24fps filmic motion, shallow depth of field.  NOT flat 2D cartoon, no bold outlines, not glossy CGI, no photorealism.

prompts.prompt:
Here's my prompt:

Create a 15-second cinematic anime skating-parkour sequence, anamorphic 2.39:1, as ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN CHASE SHOT.

The FIRST FRAME begins at full speed. No introduction, stationary pose, establishing shot, cuts, hidden transitions, or scene resets.

CHARACTER LOCK
Use the supplied RABBIT RACER character sheet as the exact visual reference for the heroine only. Do not reproduce its layout, labels, or typography.

Exactly ONE Rabbit Racer: the same face, white high ponytail, pink rabbit-ear racing helmet, white cropped racing top, oversized white-and-dusty-pink sleeves, black shorts, separate black thigh-high compression legwear, fingerless gloves, and integrated R-07 racing skates.

Preserve the reference silhouette, exposed upper-thigh areas, armor details, proportions, and white, dusty-pink, burgundy, black, and cyan palette. Do not replace her outfit with a full bodysuit.

Her rabbit ears are rigid helmet components. Her ponytail, sleeves, and fabric react naturally to speed.

R-07 SKATES
Preserve the reference mechanical skate construction: pink-and-white shells, visible wheels, articulated components, and cyan energy cores.

Wheels visibly roll against solid surfaces. Magnetic traction allows brief wall-riding on designated metal panels. Cyan acceleration pulses assist propulsion but never replace skating with effortless flight.

No new boots, disappearing wheels, rocket wings, or equipment transformations.

CONCEPT — THE HIGH-LINE SHORTCUT
Rabbit Racer is racing toward an elevated checkpoint before its access route closes. She takes a dangerous maintenance shortcut through the city.

This is athletic skating parkour: powerful strides, one-handed vaults, wall-rides, compressed landings, low sliding clearance, and committed gap jumps.

Every obstacle triggers a clear physical response. Maintain forward momentum while showing believable braking, compression, and acceleration.

ENVIRONMENT
Neo-Tokyo, 2188: a futuristic racing district with stacked magnetic tracks, maintenance walkways, suspended glass bridges, hovering transport vehicles, and a cloud-level racing circuit.

The entire route belongs to ONE connected elevated structure. Establish upcoming obstacles within the moving frame before she reaches them.

Late-sunset amber light mixes with pink-and-cyan neon. Recently wet surfaces reflect the city. Thin mist and steam create depth without hiding the route.

Spectators remain safely behind barriers. All road traffic uses hover or magnetic propulsion; visible wheels belong only to her racing skates.

0–3s — FULL-SPEED APPROACH AND VAULT
Start directly behind Rabbit Racer, already accelerating along an elevated racing boulevard. Her ponytail streams backward, knees flexed, torso low.

A maintenance barrier blocks the lane ahead. Beyond it, a sloped service panel connects to the outer metal wall.

Without stopping, she plants her left palm on the barrier’s top rail, tucks both knees, and performs a compact one-handed vault. Her skates clear the rail without clipping.

She lands on the sloped panel with compressed knees and immediately carries that momentum onto the adjacent magnetic wall.

Camera follows over the barrier on a slightly higher trajectory, keeping her whole body readable.

3–6s — WALL-RIDE AND TRANSFER
She carves along the wall above the closed lane, both skates visibly contacting its metal surface. Cyan magnetic traction glows tightly beneath the wheels.

Her body banks with the wall; one hand extends for balance. Keep the wall-ride short, fast, and physically connected to her entry momentum.

Ahead, the wall ends beside an open maintenance passage.

She compresses her legs and kicks away from the wall, crossing the short gap diagonally into the passage. She lands one skate slightly before the other, absorbs the impact, and resumes a low racing stance.

The camera follows on a wider parallel arc. Maintain a stable sense of gravity; do not roll the entire image upside down.

6–9s — LOW CLEARANCE
A heavy service crossbeam spans the passage at waist height, already visible as she lands.

She folds into a deep skating crouch, one leg slightly extended forward, chest close to her knees, and glides beneath it. Her helmet ears clear the beam by a small but visible margin.

Her gloved fingertips briefly skim the floor for balance. Tiny sparks come from a skate guard touching a metal seam.

The camera lowers behind her and passes through the SAME opening. No cut concealed by the beam.

She rises directly into two strong accelerating strides. Ahead, the passage opens onto a short glass skybridge.

9–12s — THE BREAKING BRIDGE
A damaged center section of the skybridge tilts downward, opening a short gap between the near platform and the intact far section.

Show both the takeoff edge and landing surface in the same moving view.

She bends deeply, drives off the solid edge, and jumps across. Her trajectory is one clean forward arc, not hovering.

At the apex, she draws her knees upward as a few glass fragments fall beneath her. Keep the action at near-real-time speed; no prolonged slow motion.

She lands on the intact far section with bent knees and both wheels gripping, then carves into the upward exit ramp without stopping.

The camera crosses the gap behind her on a slightly higher arc, briefly revealing the city far below while keeping her centered.

12–15s — CHECKPOINT BREAKOUT
The exit ramp curves directly into a large circular acceleration gate at the entrance to the cloud-level main raceway.

She leans forward and drives through the gate. A short cyan pulse intensifies beneath her skates, leaving tight fading energy trails.

The camera follows through the ring and emerges with her above the skyline. The previously enclosed route opens into an enormous suspended racing circuit.

She settles into a low aerodynamic stance and continues accelerating along the solid track.

End while she is still racing forward, with the camera struggling to keep pace and the city stretching beneath the track. No stop, victory pose, or fade to black.

CAMERA
One continuous rear chase shot, usually slightly offset so her silhouette and upcoming obstacles remain visible.

The camera behaves like an agile racing camera physically pursuing her along a continuous traversable route. Controlled vibration, small tracking errors, and wind buffeting communicate speed.

Keep Rabbit Racer near the center of frame. Use a moderately wide cinematic lens so her full body, contact points, and obstacles remain readable.

No teleports, impossible passage through solid structures, disconnected locations, reverse-angle cuts, or prolonged frontal views.

VISUAL STYLE
Ultra-detailed Japanese anime with cinematic material rendering, crisp character linework, expressive animation, subtle film grain, and restrained realistic motion blur.

Preserve readable hands, skates, helmet, and landing contact. Let peripheral scenery carry most of the speed blur.

Pink, cyan, white, and dusty rose accents against a dense futuristic city. Wet reflections, atmospheric depth, and restrained volumetric lighting. No lens flare.

PHYSICS AND CONTINUITY
Each action connects directly into the next:
vault → wall contact → kick-off → landing → low clearance → acceleration → gap jump → landing → acceleration gate.

Show clear takeoff, airborne trajectory, and landing for every jump.
Magnetic adhesion works only while the skates touch designated metal surfaces.
No sustained unsupported flight.
No skating on empty air.
No intersecting barriers or changing obstacle dimensions.
No duplicated heroine, extra limbs, costume changes, or skate redesigns.
The same connected city route remains visible throughout.

AUDIO
No music and no dialogue.

Only precise action sound design: wheels gripping ceramic and metal, magnetic traction hum, skate acceleration, glove contact on the rail, landing impacts, wind, metal scraping, cracking glass, distant hover traffic, muffled crowd reactions, and her controlled breathing.

Sound builds with speed and opens into a broader rushing wind as she emerges onto the skyline raceway.

No subtitles, text overlays, watermarks, or interface graphics.

REFs + Prompt: 

+ Video 1: Blender Previs Render
+ Contact Sheet 1: Car Refs 
+ Contact Sheet 2: Env Plates + Cinemotagraphy Refs

Generate a brand-new finished film. [V1] is a rough low-poly previz storyboard: follow its single continuous camera path, its gentle drift and occasional jolts, its altitude, framing, car positions, lead changes, crash motion and beat timing second for second, and take NOTHING else from it: not its faceted boxy shapes, flat shading, blank beige ground or pale sky. The dark wedge car is the black muscle car in [CHARGER]: 1970 coupe, chrome supercharger bursting through the hood, chrome bumpers, slotted wheels. The orange wedge car is the orange sports coupe in [SUPRA]: green tribal side graphics, tall silver rear wing, five-spoke silver wheels. [LOOK] is the film look; its blurred patches are not part of the scene.

The world is Terminal Island in the Port of Los Angeles, around 2001. Every shape in [V1] becomes this real place, and [P1] to [P7] are photographs of these exact streets: match their poles, wires, screens, fences, buildings, cranes, crossing hardware, train and road surface. [P1] is Terminal Way: the street and its screen-and-pole corridor. [P2] is the start by the old cannery. [P3] is the Vincent Thomas Bridge behind the container cranes. [P4] is the approach to the Earle Street crossing. [P5] is its warning lamps and crossbuck. [P6] is the freight train. [P7] is the green truck and the overhead conveyor at the crash site. The roads are long, flat, straight industrial streets of faded cracked asphalt with tar-snake patches, potholes and a worn double-yellow centre line, gravel and litter in the gutters. Both sides are lined with tall, weathered wooden utility poles, close together, with crossarms, transformers and heavy sagging bundles of wire, receding in rhythm to the vanishing point. The green blocks are olive-green corrugated sheet-metal fences and chain-link topped with barbed wire, with faded rust-brown and grey shipping containers stacked behind them. The white blocks are low, windowless tuna-cannery warehouses with sun-faded cream walls, peeling paint, loading docks and flat tar roofs crowded with vents. The trees are scraggly eucalyptus and a few tall thin palms. Red-and-white container gantry cranes stand on the skyline, and the towers and cables of the long green-grey Vincent Thomas suspension bridge rise in the haze beyond the rooftops. Hot late-afternoon sun, ochre air, dust hanging over the road.

One unbroken take from a racing FPV drone carrying a small cinema camera: amber highlights, muted olive greens, deep warm shadows, hard shadows, fine grain, soft bloom.

The cars are fighting, never gliding: body roll into every swerve, squat under throttle, noses dipping on shifts, rear ends twitching, suspension bouncing over patched asphalt, tyres chirping, exhaust heat and dust kicking out behind them.

Real piloted flight, never floating CGI: banked turns carry momentum, a light constant float and prop-wash shiver, with a few hard jolts only at the big moments (the rails, the impact, the landing). Foreground constantly cuts through the frame: poles and wires whipping past the lens edge, fence posts and barbed wire smearing by, grit and dust thrown up by the tyres hitting the lens, a smudge on the glass catching the sun, flare streaking across. Fast vintage glass: razor-thin focus, focus missing for a beat then snapping to the cars, background smeared in directional motion blur, heat shimmer.

0-1.5s: high over the old cannery blocks near Tuna Street (P2), the frame breathing on the wind; the two cars small, side by side at the line.
1.5-3.5s: launch: the black car's front wheels lift in a wheelie and it jumps a car length ahead, tyre smoke behind both cars.

Seedance 2.5｜10秒｜9:16竖屏
自然写实的户外足球场互动，一个连续长镜头。

【人物绑定】
@图片1为唯一人物角色卡，人物外貌、发型、穿着和配饰均遵循角色卡，全程保持一致。

人物左手拿着一部手机。手机从开始到结束始终留在左手，不换手、不消失。

【环境与摄影】
傍晚的户外足球场，温暖的低角度阳光从侧面照来。前景是一条沿球场边缘弯曲延伸的浅灰色水泥步道，旁边紧接着绿色草地。

右后方中远景有一座完整可见的白色足球门和球网，两名远处球员在球门附近，后方是茂密树木。人物与球门之间有清楚、无遮挡的射门空间。

镜头位于步道前方，面对走来的人物，保持自然手机拍摄般的真实感。全程连续拍摄，不剪切、不换机位、不使用慢动作。

构图同时容纳人物全身、脚边足球、足球飞行空间和远处球门。踢球与进球过程中，脚部接触和足球入网都必须看得见。

【0—3秒｜看手机走来，足球弹近】
人物左手拿手机，低头看着屏幕，沿水泥步道自然朝镜头走来，右臂随步伐轻轻摆动。

一只足球从人物身后、画面右侧的球场方向进入画面，经过几次连续的地面弹跳，逐渐接近人物脚边。每次落地后的反弹高度降低，运动轨迹自然连续。

人物察觉脚边的动静，短暂抬眼，放慢脚步并停下来。

【3—5秒｜看向球场，右脚踩停】
人物转头看向画面右后方的球场，身体随之侧转，左手仍拿着手机。足球最后低低弹落，滚到脚前。

约3.5—4.8秒，球场方向传来一位男生带距离感的呼喊：
“Sorry, can we have it back?”

这句话由远处球员说出，主要人物不对这句话做口型。

人物低眼看球，以左脚支撑身体，抬起右脚，用右脚鞋底前掌轻轻压住足球顶部，将球踩停。鞋底必须真实接触球顶，足球在接触后停止滚动。

停稳片刻，人物抬开右脚，让足球向草地边缘、球门方向轻轻滚出一小段，为射门留出空间。

【5—6秒｜转身，右脚踢出侧旋弧线球】
人物转为背对镜头、面向远处球门，快速看一眼球门位置。左手继续握着手机，右臂自然展开保持平衡。

人物以略微侧身的角度靠近足球，左脚稳稳支撑在球旁，右腿向后摆动，随后带动髋部向前转动。

约第6秒，右脚内脚背斜向擦击足球偏侧的后下部。触球既有向前的力量，也有擦过球面的横向力量，让足球获得前进速度、适度上升角度与明显侧旋。

右脚完成触球后自然横向随摆，支撑脚轻微转动释放身体力量，然后收脚站稳。动作熟练、干净、轻松，左手始终握着手机。

【6—8秒｜足球旋转、弯入球门】
足球在真实触球之后才离开地面，带着清楚的侧向旋转飞向远处球门。球面拼块随旋转改变朝向，保持真实尺寸和运动模糊。

从人物面向球门的方向看，足球先向球门右侧方向飞出，随后在持续前进的过程中平滑地向左弯回，形成一条清楚可见的侧向弧线。

轨迹同时具有适度的上升和下坠，但最醒目的特点是横向弯曲。弯曲连续自然，不突然折角，不中途停顿，不像被遥控牵引。

约7.5—8秒，足球从白色门柱之间、横梁下方进入球门，击中球网。球网被足球撞出明显凹陷，随后回弹晃动，足球落在球门内部。

必须清楚呈现完整结果：
侧旋飞行 → 平滑弯向球门 → 穿过门框范围 → 撞网 → 球网回弹。

远处球员跟随足球轨迹转头，看到球弯入球门。镜头保持连续，不能通过切镜跳过足球飞行或入网过程。

【8—10秒｜继续看手机走来，远处喊话】
人物踢完后收脚站稳，自然转回面向镜头，重新低头看左手手机，继续沿步道朝镜头走来。

姿态轻松从容，像顺手完成了一次漂亮的射门，不停下来摆庆祝姿势。

约8.3—9.5秒，球场方向传来同一位男生清楚、带惊喜和笑意的呼喊：
“I love you baby”

这是后段唯一对白，完整说一次，不添加其他词句，不重复。

人物听到后短暂抬眼，露出自然、略带得意的轻笑，随后把目光落回手机，继续走向镜头。主要人物不对这句远处呼喊做口型。

第10秒在自然行走的画面中结束，不淡黑、不定格。

【声音】
真实户外环境声：轻微风声、远处球场活动声、鞋底踩过水泥路的脚步声、足球弹跳声。

右脚触球时出现清楚的一声闷响，足球入网时有短促的球网抖动声。

两句对白都来自球场方向，带适度距离感，文字准确：

前段：“Sorry, can we have it back?”
后段：“I love you baby”

主要人物全程不说话。不要额外添加旁白、其他对白或覆盖人声的音乐。

【连续性与动作约束】
全片保持同一人物、同一只足球、同一部左手持握的手机。

严格保持动作顺序：
足球弹跳接近 → 右脚前掌踩球顶停住 → 松脚让球滚出少许 → 转身看球门 → 左脚支撑 → 右脚内脚背擦击 → 足球带侧旋离地 → 平滑弯入球门 → 撞网 → 人物转回继续走。

侧旋来自右脚与球侧面的真实擦击。脚尚未接触足球时，球不能提前飞走。

足球只射出一次，只进入球门一次。不要增加颠球、重复射门、脚后跟踢球或人物原地旋转表演。

足球不能只落在球门附近，必须穿过门框并撞到球网。不要穿过门柱、横梁或球网，不要突然瞬移进门。

避免足球复制、球体漂浮、轨迹折角、手脚变形、手机换手、人物变脸、服装变化和背景位置跳动。

不添加轨迹光线、火焰、漫画特效、字幕、标题、水印或标志。

She no longer recognizes him. He trembles, raises his firearm, looks into her face one last time and whispers:

Photorealistic cinematic live-action, high-budget action thriller. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with anamorphic primes at a T2 stop, natural motion blur, real focus pulls, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm grain, restrained cinematic grade. Low golden-hour sun raking in from one side, hard warm rim light on every edge, long shadows across the floor, deep cool shadow where the sun does not reach, fine dust and pollen drifting in the beams.

THE LOCATION: the rooftop terrace of an expensive restaurant at sunset. Polished pale stone floor, low planters of tall ornamental grass and small olive trees, a long marble bar counter down one side with glassware, white linen tables, a glass balustrade along the edge with a hazy city skyline beyond it. Warm, calm, immaculate — the wrong place for this.

FIGHTER A: a man in his late thirties, tall and lean, close-cropped greying hair, a hard weathered face with a flattened nose. He wears an expensive charcoal suit, jacket open, white shirt pulled loose at the collar, tie gone, sleeves shoved up his forearms, polished black shoes. Identical in every shot.

FIGHTER B: a woman in her early thirties, athletic and quick, dark hair in a low knot coming loose, sharp features. She wears a fitted deep-olive jumpsuit with the sleeves pushed up, a thin leather belt, flat leather boots. Identical in every shot.

CHOREOGRAPHY RHYTHM — the most important instruction: the fight plays in short sharp bursts separated by held beats, never as one continuous blur. Each burst is two or three clearly readable strikes, then both fighters reset and breathe for a moment before the next burst. Every strike lands as a distinct legible action with real weight and visible recoil. Keep the action spaced and readable rather than crowded.

CAMERA RULE: the camera stays locked to the fighters' level and moves with them so both bodies remain sharp and readable at all times while the terrace streaks past behind them. It whip-follows each strike, then settles during the held beats. It never floats free and never cuts to a distant observer angle.

16:9. 15 seconds, SIX shots, hard cuts only. Motion starts on frame 1, no opening freeze. Nobody speaks, no dialogue, no lip-sync.

SHOT 1 — 0.0s to 2.5s — CAMERA: medium, low angle, tracking hard laterally with them. INTENT: open mid-fight at full speed, and let the beauty of the setting land in the same frame as the violence.
She drives in and lands a fast double jab that snaps his head back twice, then a low kick that buckles his lead leg. He gives ground three steps into the low sun, warm light blowing out behind them both. They reset, breathing.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.5s to 5.0s — CAMERA: close, low angle, locked off, shaking on impact. INTENT: one clean readable exchange so the fight has weight before it gets faster.
He comes in heavy and throws a hook. She catches it forearm to forearm with a hard slap of contact, steps inside, and drives an elbow up into his jaw. His head snaps sideways into the light.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 — 5.0s to 7.5s — CAMERA: wide, tracking hard with them, whipping. INTENT: consequence — the setting takes the damage, which is half the point.
He shoves her backward along the marble bar counter. Glassware sweeps off it and shatters across the stone floor in a long spray, a planter goes over, and she rolls off the counter and comes straight back at him.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.5s to 10.0s — CAMERA: locked to her, wide-angle, moving with her. INTENT: the turn — she stops defending and starts pressing.

プロンプトはこちら

15秒、縦型。固定カメラ、ワンカットで完結する、高品質な手描き2Dアニメーション。

【映像の目的】

プロフィール画面の円形アイコンにいる女の子本人が、アイコンの中から小さな全身キャラクターとして抜け出し、日本の初秋を感じる飾り付けをプロフィール画面へ施す。

登場、移動、飾り付け、帰還までを、一つの連続した因果関係のある動作として描く。

【参照画像の役割】

@Image 1を、プロフィール画面、UI、初期構図、色、文字、数値、ヘッダー画像、円形アイコンの唯一の参照とする。

@Image 1を開始フレーム兼、位置を固定した背景プレートとして扱う。

プロフィール画面に表示されている既存の文字、表示名、ユーザー名、自己紹介、リンク、日付、フォロー数、フォロワー数、ボタン、認証バッジ、アイコン、固定投稿、ステータスバー、ナビゲーションの内容と位置を最後まで変化させない。

既存の文字を再生成、書き換え、翻訳、変形させない。画面をスクロールしない。

ヘッダー画像内の人物は静止画のまま。動き出すのは円形プロフィールアイコン内の女の子一人だけ。

【キャラクター固定】

円形アイコンの女の子本人。

白いキャップ、茶色のボブからミディアムヘア、大きな茶色の瞳、ゆったりしたグレーのパーカー、黒いショートパンツ、白いソックス、白いスニーカー。赤いリンゴを一つ持っている。

顔、髪型、髪色、帽子、衣装、配色、線、塗り、柔らかな2Dイラストの質感をアイコンから変えない。

実写化、3D化、別人化、衣装変更、過度なデフォルメは禁止。

外へ出たときも小さな全身キャラクターとして、手足の長さと関節を自然に維持する。キャラクターを複製しない。アイコンの中と外へ同時に二人存在させない。

【季節と装飾】

季節は日本の初秋。

金木犀、淡いピンクの秋桜、すすき、山吹色の銀杏、小さなどんぐり、赤いリンゴ、琥珀色の落ち葉を使う。

山吹色、琥珀色、橙色、くすみ赤、淡い桃色を中心とした、温かく可愛い手描きの飾り。

春の桜、夏の花火、雪、クリスマス、ハロウィンなど、別の季節や行事のモチーフは混ぜない。

飾りはヘッダー下端、アイコンの外周、画面四隅、文字のない余白へ控えめに配置する。既存の文字、数値、顔、ボタン、投稿を覆わない。

【カメラと空間】

カメラはプロフィール画面の真正面に完全固定。

ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、揺れ、スクロール、カット、画面転換なし。

プロフィール画面を立体的なスマートフォンへ変換せず、画面自体を一枚の平面として維持する。スマートフォン本体、手、指、机、周囲の風景は映さない。

キャラクターだけが画面の平面上を歩き、装飾を取り付ける。

【時間構成】

0.0–3.0秒：

プロフィール画面は完全に静止している。

円形アイコンの女の子が一度ゆっくり瞬きをして、アイコンの外を見回す。アイコンの縁に、暖かな琥珀色の光が細く走る。

女の子は持っている赤いリンゴをいったんアイコンの縁へ置き、両手を縁にかける。右脚、左脚の順にアイコンから外へ出し、身体を持ち上げて、アイコン右側の広い白い余白へ軽く着地する。

身体はアイコン内の大きさから、画面の高さの約18％ほどの小さな全身サイズへ滑らかに変化する。カットや瞬間移動は使わない。

女の子が外へ出たあとのアイコン内は、人物のいない元の黄色い背景になる。分身は残さない。

3.0–8.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの縁に置いたリンゴを拾い、白い余白を右へ二歩進む。

左足で止まり、身体を軽くひねりながら、リンゴを持った右手を左下から右上へ大きく振る。

その手とリンゴの軌道に正確に追従して、細い琥珀色の光のリボンが伸びる。光が通過した場所にだけ、金木犀、銀杏、すすきで作られた細い秋のガーランドが、ヘッダー画像の下端へ順番に取り付けられる。

装飾が先に突然出現してはいけない。腕の動き、光の軌道、飾りの出現を完全に連動させる。

動作に合わせて髪、キャップのつば、パーカーの裾が小さく遅れて揺れる。

8.0–12.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの横へ戻り、片膝をつく。

左手の指先でアイコンの外周を半円状になぞると、その指先を追って秋桜、どんぐり、小さな葉、平面的なリンゴの飾りが一つずつ並び、控えめな秋のリースになる。

続けて両手を画面の左右へ開く。数枚の琥珀色の落ち葉が左右の余白へ舞い、軽く回転しながら減速して、それぞれ安全な余白へ着地する。

葉には適度な慣性と空気抵抗を与える。文字やボタンの上には着地させない。

女の子が持つ実物の赤いリンゴは一つだけ。装飾のリンゴは小さな平面モチーフとして明確に区別する。

12.0–15.0秒：

女の子は完成した飾りを左右に見渡し、満足そうに小さくうなずく。

リンゴを胸元へ抱え、アイコンへ向かって二歩走り、縁へ片手をついて軽く跳び込む。身体は連続的に小さくなりながら、元の円形アイコンの中へ戻る。

14.2秒までに、アイコンは@Image 1と同じ、赤いリンゴを持った元の構図へ完全に復帰する。

女の子がアイコンの中から一度だけ可愛くウインクする。最後に銀杏の葉が一枚だけゆっくり降り、右上の文字のない余白へ着地する。

最終0.5秒は動きを落ち着かせ、秋の飾り付けが完成したプロフィール画面を見せる。

【音】

セリフ、ナレーション、歌、字幕、背景音楽なし。

アイコンから出る瞬間に小さな紙の「ふわっ」という音。

飾りが取り付けられるたびに、柔らかな葉擦れと小さなステッカー音。

アイコンへ戻ってウインクする瞬間に、透明感のある短いベル音を一度だけ鳴らす。

音は必ず画面内の動作と同期させる。

【最終状態】

既存のプロフィール画面とすべての文字情報は@Image 1のまま。

女の子は円形アイコンへ戻り、分身は存在しない。

初秋の装飾だけが、既存情報を邪魔しない余白へ美しく残っている。

新しい文字、ロゴ、字幕、透かしを追加しない。

Cinematic photorealistic live-action Japanese tokusatsu ninja action film.

人物は実在する俳優のような自然な骨格、筋肉、皮膚、顔立ちを持つ。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic 3D animated drama, driven entirely by a conversation between two men. Expressive, believable faces, restrained acting, detailed clothing, natural body movement and precise English lip sync. No narration.

SETTING:
An elegant watch showroom with glass counters, warm display lighting and soft daylight through the entrance. Only two characters appear.

CHARACTER CONTINUITY:
ARMY OFFICER: A 35-year-old man with short black hair, light stubble and a composed expression. Wears a faded olive civilian jacket, plain gray shirt, worn jeans and dusty boots. His military identity is initially concealed. A military identification card stays inside his jacket until the reveal. Quiet, steady voice.

SALES MANAGER: A 40-year-old man with slick black hair, a fitted navy suit and silver tie. Initially wears a dismissive smile and looks down at the customer’s clothing. Clipped, condescending voice that becomes hesitant after the reveal.

Maintain identical faces, clothing, voices and showroom layout throughout. Officer stands screen-left; manager stands screen-right across the counter.

0–5 SECONDS — IMMEDIATE HUMILIATION:
Begin mid-conversation in a medium two-shot. The manager pulls a watch tray away from the officer’s reaching hand. Cut closer as the manager glances at his dusty jacket.
MANAGER, sneering: “Try the market outside. These watches cost more than you make.”

5–10 SECONDS — A PERSONAL REASON:
Reverse close-up. The officer lowers his hand without anger, holding the manager’s gaze.
OFFICER, quietly: “It’s for my father. I haven’t seen him in three years.”

10–14 SECONDS — THE INSULT:
Close-up of the manager leaning against the counter with a smug half-smile.
MANAGER, sarcastically: “What happened? Couldn’t hold down a job?”

14–20 SECONDS — IDENTITY REVEAL:
Medium shot of the officer opening his jacket and deliberately placing his military identification card on the counter. Brief insert of the card with his matching portrait and a military emblem; avoid relying on readable small text. Return to his face.
OFFICER, level and controlled: “Army captain. Three years deployed. I came straight from the base.”

20–24 SECONDS — THE CHANGE:
Close-up of the manager. His smile disappears. He straightens and slides the watch tray back toward the officer.
MANAGER, stumbling slightly: “Captain… I’m sorry. Let me show you—”

24–30 SECONDS — THE FINAL LINE:
Slow push toward the officer. He leaves the watch untouched and retrieves his identification card.
OFFICER, firm, without raising his voice: “Would you be sorry if I weren’t? Keep the watch.”
Finish on the manager’s ashamed expression as the officer turns toward the exit.

AUDIO:
Speak only the exact written dialogue, in the assigned order. Natural conversational pacing with brief reaction pauses. Never overlap voices or swap speakers. Keep dialogue prominent. Only subtle showroom room tone, jacket rustle and the soft sound of the card touching glass. No music.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:
Use clean shot/reverse-shot editing, eye-level framing and a consistent screen direction. Show emotional changes through eyes, posture and small facial movements. The officer remains dignified; the manager’s embarrassment is believable, not exaggerated.

AVOID:
Subtitles, captions, narration, extra characters, extra dialogue, military uniform transformations, weapons, shouting, slapstick, distorted hands, changing faces, random camera spins or a prolonged silent introduction.

Their leader wears a sharply tailored black pantsuit over a cream top, with sleek straight hair and small gold hoops. She holds an iPhone 17 Pro Max vertically, filming the protagonist to intimidate her. The other three girls stand behind her, laughing. Keep each girl’s face and outfit consistent.
SETTING:
An exceptionally wealthy Indian international school during a senior-school free-dress day. A long, grand corridor with polished ivory marble flooring, brass detailing, dark walnut wall panels, recessed champagne-coloured metal lockers, glass classrooms, trophy displays, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a landscaped courtyard.

Her supernatural power is inspired respectfully by Maa Durga: protective strength, courage, and controlled resistance to cruelty.

[0–6s] — HUMILIATION

The protagonist looks toward the phone lens.

[6–10s] — AWAKENING
Medium profile two-shot. Holding her phone in her left hand, the leader raises her right hand to slap the protagonist.

The protagonist raises an open palm.

[16–22s] — DURGA-INSPIRED REVEAL

A restrained crimson-gold aura gathers behind the protagonist’s shoulders. For one brief moment, an abstract trident-shaped pattern appears within the backlight—an impression formed from light and drifting particles.

Photorealistic cinematic 1970s Mediterranean seaside fish market, colorful striped awnings, weathered stone streets, overflowing seafood stalls, hanging lanterns, wooden crates, bright coastal sunlight, lively crowds, fluttering seagulls, realistic handheld cinematography, rich environmental detail, heavy natural film grain.

0-4s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman in her early 20s sits alone at a tiny outdoor café table beside the bustling market, calmly eating lemon gelato. Around her, energetic fishmongers shout prices while customers negotiate loudly. A cheerful vendor walks through the crowd carrying a massive tray stacked with fresh fish, shrimp, octopus, lemons and a bucket of crushed ice. An excited tourist suddenly rushes backward to photograph the harbor.

4-8s: [Dynamic Tracking] The tourist slams into the vendor. Fish, ice, lemons, trays, buckets and seawater explode into the air in spectacular slow motion. Hundreds of ice cubes sparkle in sunlight while silver fish tumble through space. The camera instantly begins a fast continuous orbit around the collision. Time freezes at the exact peak of the chaos. Every person and every seagull stops completely. Only the young woman continues enjoying her gelato without the slightest concern.

8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides elegantly through the frozen marketplace. Water hangs as crystal ribbons and suspended droplets. Fish, shrimp, octopus, lemons, ice cubes, baskets and wooden crates float weightlessly with incredible realism. Market vendors, tourists and children remain frozen in exaggerated expressions. The young woman calmly takes another spoonful of gelato while the entire frozen world except her begins smoothly rewinding. Every droplet, every fish, every crate, every person and every flying bird retraces its path perfectly back to the starting positions.

17-24s: [Medium Shot] The rewind finishes flawlessly. The vendor once again carries the fully loaded tray. The young woman casually points toward the rushing tourist with a tiny smile. The vendor instinctively steps aside just before the collision would have happened. Disaster completely avoided. Nearby customers never realize anything almost occurred.

24-30s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face as she finishes the final spoonful of gelato. A quiet knowing smile appears while the lively market continues normally behind her. Warm sunlight, shimmering sea reflections, soft coastal breeze, creamy cinematic bokeh.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid simulation, realistic fish and ice physics, physically accurate water behavior, cinematic motion blur only on moving elements, stable character identity, vibrant Mediterranean atmosphere, feature-film quality, heavy natural film grain, seamless temporal coherence, extremely high rewatch value.

道路、车辆、铁路和城市建筑依照由近到远的顺序从地面立体向上拔起。

东京球体保持原有球形体积，不落回地面。

清水寺、八坂塔、石板阶梯、传统町屋、红色鸟居与远处青山构成层次丰富的京都球体。

几片花瓣以不同景深从镜头前方轻轻飘过。

蓝天上方依次出现巨大白色文字：

Nagoya Travel Diary

名古屋球体在女主脚下继续缓慢转动约15–20度。

城市道路上微小车辆持续运动，远处云层缓慢漂移，阳光照亮名古屋城与城市天际线。

摄影机轻轻后拉，完整展示：
巨型NAGOYA标题、扶草帽的女主、微缩城市球体、左右两侧地标与天空。

29.5秒，镜头运动逐渐停止。

最后0.5秒完整定格为一张清晰的16:9横屏旅行封面。

【声音设计】

00–04秒：东京街头环境音、急促脚步声、真实奔跑呼吸声，节奏逐渐增强。

04–07秒：音乐加速、突然的撞击声、短暂慌乱脚步。

16–23秒：球体连续旋转声、轻盈日式铃声、京都文字弹跳音。

23–30秒：旋转加速、明快音乐鼓点、名古屋标题弹跳音，最终快门定格音收尾。

整体音乐为明快、有节奏变化的J-pop电子旅行广告配乐。三次城市关键变换与音乐重拍同步。

禁止人物身份改变、脸部漂移、肢体畸形、跑步动作漂浮、吐司穿模、撞击缺少接触、物体错误消失。

人物始终是主要视觉锚点，三座球体保持一致的空间结构、摄影透视、画面位置与整体尺度。

全片保持超写实摄影级画质、连续镜头逻辑与一致的旅行广告美学。

FERRARI F80 | UNDER PRESSURE
Duration: 30 seconds | Format: 9:16 vertical
Style: Photorealistic, high-end live-action Ferrari commercial

CREATIVE DIRECTION
EVERY SYSTEM IS UNDER PRESSURE. NOTHING LOSES CONTROL.
Create a professional automotive commercial progressing through Ferrari identity, engineering, acceleration, driver control, braking, cornering, extreme speed and composure.

Use the uploaded professional commercial for realistic camera behavior, natural vibrations, aggressive cropping, motion blur, foreground occlusion and editing rhythm. Do not copy its location or shots.

The footage must feel physically captured, never artificially generated.

REFERENCES
Image 4: Exact F80 front and rear geometry.
Image 3: Side profile, wheelbase and top proportions.
Image 5: Front three-quarter geometry.
Images 2, 6–10: Exact cockpit, seats, steering wheel, dashboard and controls.
Video 1: Supplied video reference. Use only the camera, driving, instrument or sound behavior actually demonstrated.

DRIVER_REFERENCE: Exact face, hair, skin, body, outfit and hands.
LOCATION AND LIGHTING
One continuous northern-Italian mountain road inspired by Lake Garda/Tremosine, without copying an exact location.
Dark limestone walls, wet winding asphalt, stone guardrails, occasional short rock-cut tunnels, Italian vegetation, distant lake views and misty mountain ridges.

Cloudy, slightly dark daylight after light rain. Fine atmospheric moisture, subtle mist, no storm or sunset.

Natural overcast lighting, rich Ferrari red against cool gray-green surroundings, realistic wet-road reflections, water beads, moving body reflections, soft highlights and detailed shadows.

Maintain the same physical road, geography, weather and forward travel direction throughout.

CAMERA AND PHYSICS

Use real automotive camera positions: macro, low rear three-quarter, side tracking, interior shoulder, restrained aerial, wheel detail, low front three-quarter and fixed roadside.

Camera vibration must be physically motivated by engine pulses, asphalt, suspension, airflow or close vehicle movement. Chase rigs retain minor framing drift; aerial and fixed cameras remain stable.

No whip pans, impossible orbits, floating cameras or constant artificial shaking.

Show speed through road parallax, rotating wheels, changing reflections, suspension response, directional motion blur and sound. Keep the Ferrari readable.

Realistic mass, tire loading, grip, braking weight transfer, suspension compression, countersteering and progressive acceleration. Never weightless or exaggerated.

EXACT 30-SECOND TIMELINE

00:00–00:02.2 | SHOT 1: MECHANICAL IDENTITY

Four rapid details:

0–0.55s: 85mm exhaust/diffuser macro. Wet carbon, vibrating droplets, engine ignition.

0.55–1.10s: Ferrari front badge, wet red paint, moving reflection.
1.10–1.60s: Wheel emblem, brake rotor and caliper, initial mechanical engagement.

1.60–2.20s: Interior steering-wheel emblem and driver's hand. Subtle engine vibration.

Clean cuts synchronized with mechanical sounds.
00:02.2–00:05.0 | SHOT 2: RELEASE
40–50mm low rear three-quarter, camera 25cm above asphalt.
Ferrari dominates the midground against rock and vegetation. Engine rises; rear suspension settles slightly as the car accelerates.

Correct wheel rotation, progressive traction, subtle road spray and body vibration.

Camera remains nearly stationary initially, allowing the car to move out of frame. Strong acceleration audio.
00:05.0–00:08.0 | SHOT 3: SIDE SPEED

40–50mm matched-speed tracking at wheel height, approximately 1.5–2m from the car.

Ferrari remains relatively sharp; foreground vegetation streaks past while distant scenery moves slowly.

Show accurate side sculpture, wheel rotation, tire contact, suspension travel, moving reflections and light road spray.

Allow minor road-induced vertical vibration and natural framing drift.

00:08.0–00:09.2 | SHOT 4: DRIVER
50–70mm interior shoulder camera.

Exact driver identity. Focused eyes, natural hands, slight steering correction, restrained facial tension and realistic body response.

Dark cockpit, moving road outside, dashboard visible but secondary.

00:09.2–00:12.0 | SHOT 5: ROAD GEOGRAPHY

Restrained near-top-down aerial revealing one connected S-shaped mountain road, rock wall, distant lake/valley and Ferrari trajectory.

Follow gently without orbiting. Preserve realistic road layout and vehicle direction.
00:12.0–00:13.6 | SHOT 6A: BRAKING

Extreme front-wheel close-up at hub height.

Rotating wheel, fixed caliper, working brake assembly, front suspension loading, tire contact and fine water spray.

No frozen wheel or artificial glowing brakes.

00:13.6–00:15.0 | SHOT 6B: TURN-IN
50–65mm low front three-quarter.

Ferrari enters the bend cleanly. Correct steering angle, restrained body loading, stable tire grip and natural wet-road reflections.

Establish grip before the drift.

00:15.0–00:19.0 | SHOT 7: CONTROLLED ROTATION
Begin with low rear three-quarter as the Ferrari enters a stronger curve.

The rear briefly steps outward.

Cut precisely when the slip becomes visible to a wide elevated three-quarter camera, continuing the same physical movement.

Show road curvature, modest rear slip, correct countersteer, subtle tire haze, progressive correction and straight exit.

No spinning, donuts, direction reversal or excessive sliding. Camera movement remains restrained.
00:19.0–00:20.0 | SHOT 8: SENSORY DETAILS

Three rapid moving inserts, approximately 0.3 seconds each:

Rear taillight at speed.

Rotating rim and wheel.

Front intake/headlight edge.
Synchronize with engine pulse, gear change and exhaust beat. No static product shots.

00:20.0–00:23.5 | SHOT 9: HIGH-SPEED PASS

100–135mm fixed roadside telephoto.

Ferrari approaches from a distance and rapidly fills the frame, with realistic compressed background perspective.

Close pass creates directional blur, peak engine sound and one subtle physical camera response.

Do not chase or pan after the car.

Hold the empty road approximately 0.5 seconds as mist, moisture, light debris and engine sound settle.
00:23.5–00:30.0 | SHOT 10: FINAL RELEASE

35–50mm sustained lateral tracking along an open Italian mountain road, with wet asphalt, rock, vegetation and distant lake/valley.

Ferrari travels left-to-right in the lower-middle composition.
Keep it stable but not perfectly locked. Allow tiny camera corrections, strong foreground parallax, natural wheel blur, slight spray, suspension response and moving reflections.
No drifting, artificial effects or extra cuts.

Engine reaches its strongest sustained performance note. Music resolves underneath.

In the final second, Ferrari gains slightly on the camera and moves toward the leading third.
Cut to black while the car is moving. Display the official Ferrari emblem and FERRARI wordmark briefly before 30 seconds. Final restrained engine tail, then silence.

SOUND DESIGN

No dialogue or narration.

Ferrari engine and exhaust dominate: ignition, idle, RPM rise, gear shifts, exhaust pulses, tire contact, wet-road spray, wind, braking, cornering scrub and natural ambience.

Music remains secondary. Motivate cuts through acceleration, shifts, braking, tire loading and engine pulses.

Preserve believable engine behavior and change sound perspective with camera position. Do not invent an incorrect powertrain sound.

DASHBOARD ACCURACY
Use supplied cockpit images for exact layout and video references for verified instrument behavior.

Speed increases progressively during acceleration. RPM rises before an upshift, drops afterward and rises again. Braking reduces speed logically.

F80 engine reference limits: maximum power at 8,750 rpm, maximum operating speed 9,000 rpm, dynamic limiter 9,200 rpm.

No random gauges, warning lights, fonts or flickering numbers. If typography cannot remain accurate, keep the cluster slightly out of focus.

ABSOLUTE CONTINUITY

Maintain identical F80 body, red paint, wheels, badges, headlights, interior, driver identity, outfit, road surface, weather, lighting and driving direction.

No mirrored Ferrari, changing road geography, different dashboard, traffic, pedestrians, visible filming equipment, impossible camera movement or inconsistent vehicle physics.

Every shot must feel like another real camera covering the same continuous drive.

FINAL INTENTION: Ferrari F80 communicates pressure, precision and control through believable vehicle mass, tire contact, imperfect but professional camera behavior, natural reflections, mechanical sound and physically convincing performance.

Create a photorealistic, emotionally devastating cinematic video, approximately 24 seconds, 16:9, 24fps. A post-apocalyptic love story told entirely through visuals, without dialogue. Two infected lovers discover each other inside an abandoned train station. Their bodies have succumbed to the infection, but some forgotten part of them still recognizes the person they loved. A familiar touch awakens fragmented memories of their life together before the world collapsed. The memories feel beautiful, imperfect, and painfully real. The ending returns to the present, revealing that although their humanity is fading, their connection remains.

Visual direction: Photorealistic cinema, natural skin textures, anamorphic lens character, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, realistic handheld movement, soft lens flares, volumetric light, restrained color grading. Present-day scenes feature desaturated green-grey tones, decaying architecture, drifting dust, and cold overcast light. Memories feature warm amber sunlight, rich natural colors, and gentle halation. Emotional restraint over melodrama.

Character continuity — keep identical faces throughout:

Man: Early 30s, short messy dark-brown hair, light stubble, silver curb chain, small silver hoop in his left ear. Present-day appearance: shirtless, dark trousers, ashy grey-green skin, mottled veins, cracked lips, dirt-covered shoulders, bruising around the eyes. His irises are clouded milky-grey, with faintly veined pale sclera and small, dull pupils. His gaze remains subtly responsive. Memory appearance: healthy olive skin, dark charcoal crewneck, warm brown eyes, natural smile.

Woman: Early 30s, long wavy dirty-blonde hair, small silver nose ring, oversized black knit sweater in the present. Her skin is pale and ashy, with realistic discoloration, faint veins, and dark bruising around the eye sockets. Her irises have a cloudy blue-grey film, glassy surfaces, and muted pupils. Memory appearance: healthy skin, heather-grey T-shirt, clear blue-grey eyes, expressive laughter.

Shot-by-shot sequence

0.0–3.0s — The abandoned station

A wide cinematic shot of a deserted railway platform swallowed by weeds. A derailed train rests beneath a broken glass canopy. The infected man sits alone on a rusted bench, staring at an old photograph held between dirty fingers. Wind moves loose paper across the platform. He slowly lifts his head as faint footsteps echo in the distance. His cloudy eyes turn toward the sound. Slow dolly-in, cold green-grey palette, atmospheric silence.

3.0–5.5s — Recognition

At the far end of the platform, the infected woman emerges through drifting mist. Her oversized black sweater hangs loosely from her shoulders, her dirty-blonde hair moving in the wind. She stops beneath a flickering station light. A medium close-up reveals her pale, filmed-over irises and bruised eye sockets. She studies the distant figure as though trying to remember his face. The camera slowly pushes toward her eyes.

5.5–8.0s — The distance between them

Alternating profile shots as they walk toward each other along opposite sides of the platform. Neither moves like a predator. Their steps are uneven and hesitant. The man brushes his fingertips across a rusted metal railing; the woman pauses beside an abandoned child’s bicycle. Their dead eyes remain fixed on one another. A train carriage slides across the foreground, briefly obscuring the frame and revealing them much closer when it clears.

8.0–10.5s — The familiar gesture

They stop face-to-face beneath a shattered station clock. The woman raises one trembling hand and touches the silver chain around his neck, recognizing something familiar. He looks down at her hand, then back into her eyes. His expression barely changes, but his breathing catches faintly. Extreme close-up on their fingers touching the chain, followed by a rack focus to their clouded eyes. No snarling, no sudden movements.

10.5–12.0s — Memory begins

Her thumb brushes the chain.

Match cut to the same gesture in the past: her healthy hand resting against the same silver necklace as the man smiles at her in warm afternoon sunlight. The cold station transforms into a sunlit apartment balcony through a seamless visual transition. The soundtrack remains instrumental, with a delicate piano motif and distant ambient textures.

12.0–14.0s — A life they once had

Memory. The couple stand in a tiny apartment kitchen, cooking together. She playfully steals a piece of food from his plate. He pretends to be offended before breaking into a genuine laugh. Their clear brown and blue-grey eyes reflect the warm window light. Imperfect handheld framing, natural movement, lived-in surroundings, intimate realism rather than polished advertising aesthetics.

14.0–16.0s — The last ordinary day

Memory. They ride a bicycle together along a quiet countryside road at sunset, the woman seated behind him with her arms around his waist. She rests her cheek against his back and closes her eyes. Tall grass sways beside the road. Golden sunlight spills through the trees. The camera follows from behind, creating the feeling of a cherished moment captured before anyone knew it would become a memory.

16.0–18.0s — The world before

A brief, fragmented memory: rain against a bedroom window at night. They lie together beneath a blanket, foreheads touching, smiling quietly. Her fingers trace his cheek while he gently tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Their eyes are alive, moist, and full of warmth. A lightning flash momentarily illuminates their faces, creating a natural visual bridge to the cold present.

18.0–20.0s — Back to the station

Hard match cut to the same framing in the abandoned station. The woman’s hand is still against his cheek, but the skin beneath her fingers is cracked and grey. Her eyes are cloudy and lifeless in color. His dull milky-grey eyes remain locked on hers. The piano falls away, leaving only wind passing through broken windows and the faint metallic groan of the station.

20.0–22.0s — The almost-human moment

Extreme close-up, both faces filling the frame. The man slowly raises his hand and rests it against the woman’s cheek. A tear-like trace of moisture catches the light beneath her clouded eye, without restoring its color. She leans into his palm by the smallest amount. Their noses almost touch. Fine cracks, subtle veins, dirt, and realistic skin deterioration remain sharply detailed. No supernatural glow, no sudden transformation.

22.0–24.0s — Still together

A wider shot from behind them. They sit side by side on the rusted station bench, hands clasped, facing the abandoned tracks disappearing into the mist. Weeds move in the wind. Far above, the broken canopy lets one narrow beam of golden sunlight fall across their joined hands. The rest of the station remains cold and lifeless. The camera slowly pulls away until they become small figures in the ruined architecture.

End on their clasped hands. Fade to black. No title card.

Cinematography and performance

* Prioritize emotional storytelling through eyes, hands, posture, and subtle facial movement.
* Use motivated match cuts that connect identical gestures, compositions, and character positions across past and present.
* Maintain consistent facial identity, hairstyle, jewelry, clothing, and body proportions in every shot.
* Present-day movement should feel slow, stiff, and physically grounded, with no exaggerated zombie behavior.
* Human memories should feel spontaneous, tender, and imperfect, with believable interactions and natural expressions.
* Use realistic practical infection makeup, restrained discoloration, cracked skin, mottled veins, and bruised sockets.
* Zombie eyes must retain recognizable iris and pupil structure beneath a milky film. Never use glowing eyes, featureless white eyeballs, or black voids.
* Build emotion through visual contrast, ambient sound, and restrained pacing rather than dialogue or excessive effects.

Negative prompt: Cartoon zombies, anime, video-game graphics, plastic skin, exaggerated monster faces, glowing eyes, solid white eyes, black voids, excessive gore, exposed organs, blood splashes, face inconsistency, changing jewelry, changing eye colors in the present, extra fingers, deformed hands, artificial facial expressions, rubbery movement, oversaturated colors, excessive motion blur, random scene transitions, text, subtitles, logos, watermarks.

Create a nostalgic, casually recorded Korean salon vlog set entirely in South Korea in 2003. Preserve the same young Korean woman’s exact face, identity, skin texture, dark hair color, hair length, body proportions, Y2K outfit, and accessories throughout. Her straight hair must physically transform through the complete perm procedure.

SCENE 1 — ARRIVAL (0–5s): Handheld camcorder footage follows her into a modest neighborhood salon, showing worn styling chairs, simple mirrors, cluttered counters, old product bottles, Korean magazines, fluorescent lights, and hooded dryers. She greets the stylist and sits down.

SCENE 2 — ROD SETTING (5–10s): The stylist brushes and sections her straight hair, then carefully wraps it around traditional perm rods, securing each with elastic bands. She watches herself in the mirror, smiling nervously. Show realistic hand movements and progressively applied rods.

SCENE 3 — SOLUTION (10–15s): With all rods secured, the stylist applies perm solution using a plastic applicator bottle and places protective cotton around her hairline. She glances at the camera with an amused expression.

SCENE 4 — PROCESSING (15–21s): The stylist positions her beneath a traditional hooded salon dryer. She waits casually, smiling at the camera as the dryer hums. The camcorder zooms awkwardly and briefly loses focus. Rods remain in place.

SCENE 5 — CURL REVEAL (21–26s): The stylist physically removes the rods one by one, rinses her hair at the wash basin, towels it dry, and finishes with an ordinary blow-dryer and round brush. Reveal soft, natural Korean-style curls. She touches a curl and smiles at her reflection.

SCENE 6 — DEPARTURE (26–30s): She admires her finished curls, thanks the stylist, walks outside, and turns the camcorder toward herself. Her curls bounce naturally as she walks along the same Korean street. End abruptly like an ordinary home video.

ERA & CAMERA: Every detail must authentically match South Korea in 2003: salon equipment, packaging, signage, storefronts, vehicles, clothing, makeup, and technology. Use genuine consumer MiniDV characteristics: shaky handheld movement, imperfect framing, crooked horizons, awkward optical zooms, autofocus hunting, mild CCD noise, soft DV detail, compression artifacts, clipped highlights, and fluorescent white-balance imperfections. No modern equipment, smartphones, luxury interiors, cinematic shots, gimbals, HDR, artificial film grain, VHS distortion, or heavy retro filters.

AUDIO: Natural Korean conversations, salon tools, clicking rods, dryer hum, running water, footsteps, and distant street ambience. No music, cinematic sound design, or scripted narration.

STRICT CONTINUITY: Maintain the same girl, face, outfit, stylist, salon, and surroundings. Follow the exact sequence: arrival → sectioning and rods → solution → processing → rod removal, rinsing and styling → departure. No skipped steps, instant curls, identity drift, teleportation, or unexplained transitions.

FINAL LOOK: A genuine forgotten Korean home-video recording from 2003—not a modern video with a retro filter. Prioritize realistic hair physics, natural behavior, period accuracy, continuous action, and imperfect consumer-camera footage over cinematic polish.

prompts.prompt:
【场景概述】
一场在日本高中教学楼内进行的PUBG大逃杀对局，以写实真人影像呈现。整栋校舍被布置成对局场地，楼内只有六名玩家：世界顶尖水平的PUBG玩家、女高中生NAGI，以及五位全副PUBG装备、兴致勃勃参赛的老师。规则像拿着枪玩的抓人游戏：所有子弹都是粉笔弹，每一次爆头都在对方头盔上炸开一团白色粉笔灰，被击中的人进入PUBG"击倒"姿态，双手双膝着地，活着并小声嘟囔。全片为一个30秒的连续长镜头：前24秒始终从NAGI背后拍摄，最后摄影机环绕到她的正面，拍下她胜利的表情。所有台词均为日语，画面中不出现字幕。

【参考素材】
@Image1 = NAGI。与参考图100%一致：黑色长直发、齐刘海，白色短袖水手服，领口有粉色条纹，粉色缎面蝴蝶结，深灰色百褶裙，黑色及膝袜，白色运动鞋。NAGI手持一把装有红点瞄准镜的M4A1卡宾枪，枪托紧抵右肩。她的后腰挂着一口PUBG平底锅，腰带上别着一枚手雷。声音：清澈、冷静、略低的少女声线。

【对手玩家】（五名日本教师，每人在日常教职员服装外穿戴PUBG军用头盔和战术背心，每人的武器各不相同）
班主任：男性，三十五岁左右，藏青色运动服，脖子上挂着哨子。武器：AKM，木质护木和枪托，弯曲的弹匣。声音洪亮粗犷。
女教师：女性，四十出头，米色开衫和长裙。武器：MP5K，短小紧凑的冲锋枪，双手握持。声音严厉清脆。
教导主任：瘦削男性，五十多岁，银框眼镜，灰色西装。武器：S686双管霰弹枪。声音尖细、一本正经。
理科老师：男性，二十多岁，白大褂。武器：Micro UZI，方正的小型冲锋枪，单手举着。声音年轻、语速快。
校长：体态敦实的男性，六十多岁，棕色三件套西装，头戴PUBG三级头盔。武器：一口PUBG平底锅，握在右手。声音低沉浑厚。

【场景布局】
日本高中教学楼二楼的走廊。左侧是一整排窗户，午后的阳光在亚麻地板上投下一格一格的光斑；右侧是一间间教室的推拉门和钢制储物柜；走廊尽头是楼梯间。
PUBG物资散落各处：地板上的绷带卷和带白十字的红色急救包，窗台上的能量饮料罐和止痛药瓶，课桌上的一顶三级头盔。
窗外的操场上有一个空投箱，冒着一柱红色烟雾。

【首帧与站位】
从背后看到NAGI，她已经贴着右侧墙面压低重心快步前进，位于画面右侧三分之一处，M4A1举在头部高度，枪口预瞄前方的教室门口。后腰的平底锅清晰可见。画面左侧三分之二是洒满阳光的走廊纵深。

【镜头形式】
单一连续长镜头，一镜到底，全程30秒。

【光学】
63°视场角，直线投影，深景深，NAGI与走廊深处的目标都清晰可辨。快速转身时带自然的运动模糊。

【摄影机】
由真人摄影师操作的PUBG第三人称跟随镜头：位于NAGI身后1.5米，略高于肩部，带半拍延迟和轻微的手持晃动。她贴墙或探头时，摄影机移到她外侧肩膀后方，越过她的肩膀看到目标。0秒至24.5秒摄影机始终在她身后，她的脸只在转头时以侧脸短暂出现。24.5秒起摄影机绕过她的右肩，环绕半圈来到她的正面。

【顶尖玩家的操作】
NAGI的每个动作都是世界顶尖PUBG选手的水准。枪口始终预瞄在头部高度，对准下一个门口或拐角。举枪与开枪是同一个动作：枪托到位的同一瞬间子弹出膛。每个目标只用一发点射。移动简洁、贴墙、利用掩体，用侧身探头的方式开枪，只露出枪和半个上身。

【动作】
[阶段1 | 0秒至4.5秒] NAGI以10公里/小时贴墙前进。班主任从前方12米的教室门里跨出来，用日语喊：{なぎ！ろうかを走るな！}，端起AKM打出一个三连发，粉笔弹在NAGI身旁的墙上炸出三个白点。NAGI脚步不停，枪口微调的同一瞬间开出一枪，粉笔弹的白色细线划过走廊，他的头盔炸开一团粉笔灰，双手双膝着地。结束状态：他跪在门边摇头；NAGI从他身旁掠过。

[阶段2 | 4.5秒至10秒] 承接上一阶段：同一条走廊，摄影机仍在NAGI身后。NAGI背靠下一间教室的门框停住。女教师蹲在教室里翻倒的课桌后，用日语喊：{しゅくだいは出したの？}，同时用MP5K打出两个短点射，粉笔弹在门框上炸出一串白点。NAGI先快速露出半个肩膀引她开火，立刻缩回；对方枪声一停，NAGI压低成蹲姿，从另一个高度侧身探头，探出与开枪同时完成，一发命中头盔，粉笔灰炸开。女教师坐在课桌之间，双手扶正头盔。NAGI收回掩体，平静地用日语说：{あした出します}。结束状态：女教师坐着叹气；NAGI起身继续前进。

[阶段3 | 10秒至16.5秒] 教导主任和理科老师躲在前方办公室里堆满讲义的办公桌后。教导主任用S686连开两枪，粉笔弹在钢制储物柜上炸出两大片白印，他用日语喊：{こうそくいはんですよ！}。理科老师单手举着Micro UZI朝走廊扫射。NAGI蹲到储物柜后，取下腰间的手雷，拔掉拉环，握在手里停两拍，再把它砸向敞开的推拉门，手雷反弹进办公室，炸成一大团充满整个房间的白色粉笔云，讲义纸在空中飘落。两人从头到脚一身雪白，咳嗽着双手双膝爬到门口，理科老师用日语说：{けいさんがいです…}。结束状态：两人跪在门口；NAGI站起身。

[阶段4 | 16.5秒至19.5秒] NAGI穿过飘散的粉笔灰继续前进，左手从窗台上拿起一罐能量饮料，边走边仰头一口喝完，右手握着M4A1保持枪口向前。窗外可以看到操场上冒着红烟的空投箱。结束状态：空罐在地板上滚动，她的双手回到步枪上。

[阶段5 | 19.5秒至24.5秒] 校长从前方8米的楼梯间跨出来，吼叫着把平底锅举在脸前当盾牌冲过来。NAGI在他现身的同一瞬间开火：第一发粉笔弹打在锅上，"当"的一声炸出白灰。她毫无停顿地向左横移一步并侧身探头，绕开平底锅的角度，第二发落在他的三级头盔上，炸开全场最大的一团粉笔灰。他双手双膝着地，平底锅在地板上打转，用日语说：{まいった…きみの勝ちだ}。结束状态：校长跪在NAGI前方4米处；NAGI站定。

[阶段6 | 24.5秒至30秒] NAGI放下M4A1，枪口朝下。摄影机绕过她的右肩，以她为圆心平稳地环绕半圈来到她的正面，同时降到胸口高度，以略低的角度停在中近景：她的脸位于画面右侧三分之一，窗外的阳光给她的黑发镶上一圈轮廓光，粉笔灰在光柱中漂浮，她身后的画面左侧是失焦的、跪着的校长。她呼出一口气，吹开贴在脸颊上的一缕头发，下巴微微抬起，眼睛微眯，一侧嘴角先扬起，随后变成露出牙齿的灿烂笑容，目光落在镜头上，用日语说：{かった、かった。ゆうはんはドンかつだ}。结束状态：她保持笑容看着镜头，头发随风轻轻飘动。

【表演】
NAGI在战斗中呼吸平稳、表情专注，说话简短从容。最后的正面镜头里，她的脸与参考图100%一致：真实的皮肤质感，眼中有窗光的反光点，胸口随呼吸起伏。老师们的表演夸张而投入，像在运动会上全力以赴的大人。

【物理】
所有子弹都是粉笔弹，在空中留下一道细细的白色轨迹。所有命中都只表现为白色粉笔灰：一团约40厘米宽的柔和粉尘，悬停一秒后缓缓飘散。手雷的效果是一大团粉笔云。衣服、皮肤、墙面和地板上只留下白色粉笔痕迹。五位老师被击倒后全都活着，并且明显还在活动。每把枪都有真实的后坐力、枪口闪光和抛出的弹壳。每次急停、下蹲和探头时，NAGI的头发、裙摆和后腰的平底锅都带有惯性。

【光线】
午后阳光从左侧窗户斜射进走廊，5200K，地板上是明暗相间的光斑，右侧墙面处于柔和的阴影中。粉笔灰在光柱里清晰可见。

【音频】
每把武器的枪声明显不同：
<M4A1：清脆、短促、高亢的单发，每次只有一声>
<AKM：低沉厚重、节奏较慢的三连发，每一声都带着沉闷的冲击>
<MP5K：紧凑干脆、速度很快的短点射，声音偏闷>
<Micro UZI：极快、尖细、连成一片的扫射，像撕开布料>
<S686：两声沉重、带着走廊回响的轰鸣>
<平底锅："当"的一声清亮的金属撞击，余音悠长>
其他声音：<黄铜弹壳落在亚麻地板上的清响>，<每次命中时粉笔灰轻柔的"噗"声>，<手雷拉环的金属声和一声闷响>，<能量饮料罐开罐的气声>，<运动鞋在地板上的摩擦声>，<老师们的咳嗽声>。每句台词都清晰可辨，说话时枪声暂停。无音乐。

【风格】
写实真人实拍质感，真实的皮肤纹理、真实的布料和真实的校舍，拍摄方式如同一场第三人称PUBG对局。画面为纯净的影像。

【一致性锁定】
从0秒到30秒为一个连续镜头。摄影机在24.5秒之前始终位于NAGI身后，只在最后环绕到她的正面。NAGI每一次交火都是举枪即开枪，一个连贯动作。NAGI从第一帧到最后一帧保持相同的发型、制服、M4A1和后腰的平底锅。五位老师各自始终拿着自己的那一件武器。校舍里只有NAGI和五位老师这六名玩家。每位老师只出现一次，之后留在原地保持击倒状态。粉笔灰是唯一的命中效果。每句台词由指定的角色说出。

prompts.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Dusk in a dense European pine forest under a flat overcast sky. A young woman in a pale grey dress runs away from camera deep into the trees, being hunted by something unseen behind her; she glances back, keeps running, then stops dead in a clearing between the trunks to listen.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@Image 1: master reference for framing, palette, light and the woman. Woman, late 20s, slim, short cropped pink hair, long loose pale grey cotton dress gathered in her right fist, dark ankle boots, faint dark tattoo on her left forearm. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: forest floor of dark moss, low ferns and brown pine needles, slightly raised toward camera.
Midground: the woman on a narrow natural path between straight, bare, near-black pine trunks set in vertical rows.
Background: trunks recede into a deep teal-green haze, fog density 25%, depth fades to near-black at 40 meters. Pale grey-white sky glimpsed in thin slits at the canopy top.
Camera sits behind her on the shadow side, operator axis aligned with her running path. Light falls from above through the canopy, soft and directionless.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Frame 1: the woman already in full stride, back to camera, centered dead in frame, small within the vertical trunks, head turned to her left over her shoulder. Symmetrical center composition: trunks frame her left and right like bars. Everyone and everything moving from frame one.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, 15 seconds total. Cuts only at the specified points, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
0.0s–5.0s — WS, 63° observational wide, rectilinear, clean soft prime character.
5.0s–8.0s — MCU profile, 29° portrait compression, background trunks melt into soft teal bokeh.
8.0s–10.5s — ECU of her boots, 12° tele-detail, low to the ground.
10.5s–15.0s — EWS, 84° wide, the forest swallows her.
No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Gentle handheld at chest height, 1–2 cm breathing tremor, the operator lags half a beat behind her. Low-contrast tonal character with wide latitude, soft highlight roll-off on the sky slits, deep shadows that keep detail in the moss and bark.

ACTION
0.0s–5.0s — She runs away from camera at 12 km/h along the path, right fist hiking the dress above her knees, left arm pumping. At 2.0s she turns her head to her left over her shoulder, eyes searching the trees behind the camera, then snaps her face forward and keeps running. Camera follows at 10 km/h, so she slowly pulls away into depth.
5.0s HARD CUT
5.0s–8.0s — Tracking profile from her left side, camera moving alongside at her speed. Her face in MCU against the passing trunks: mouth open, short hard breaths, her eyes cut sideways back behind her once, then forward to choose the gap between two trunks.
8.0s HARD CUT
8.0s–10.5s — Low ECU on the forest floor: her dark boots strike the moss and needles, kicking up brown needles and small clods of earth, the grey hem whipping past the lens. On the last step the boot plants hard and skids 10 cm to a stop.
10.5s HARD CUT
10.5s–15.0s — Static wide from far behind, low on the ground: she stands frozen in a small clearing, a pale figure centered among black trunks. Her chest heaves. She turns her head slowly to her right, listening. A single branch cracks off-screen to the left. She holds perfectly still. Camera locked off, holds to the end.

PERFORMANCE
ACTING TASK — THE WOMAN (fully invested in her tactic; the work happens in her eyes and ears):
GOAL: put enough trees between herself and the hunter to vanish from his sight.
OBSTACLE: she cannot see him; the forest hides him as well as it hides her. Every noise she makes can give her away.
TACTIC: run while reading the forest behind her — each glance back is a measurement: how close, which direction, has he seen me. When the running becomes too loud, she switches to silence and listens instead of looking.
Moment to moment:
— 2.0s glance back: searches the gaps between trunks for movement, decides "still behind me", turns forward to pick the line of trees.
— 5.0s–8.0s profile: eyes check behind once, then lock onto the darkest gap ahead — choosing where to disappear.
— 10.5s stop: holds her breath to hear better, turns her ear toward the sound, eyes wide open and tracking the darkness on her right.
Skin realism: pale skin with pore-level detail, cold flush on her cheeks and nose tip, fine sweat at the hairline, visible breath vapor in the cool air, short pink hair moving with each stride.
(Safety: gaze always engaged in the task — focused, searching, alive; natural blink cadence.)

PHYSICS
Real body weight in each stride, slight forward lean, boots sinking into soft moss. The cotton dress reacts to wind and running with inertia, the hem swinging and settling. Pine needles scatter and fall back under gravity. Breath vapor drifts and fades within 30 cm.

LIGHTING
Overcast dusk daylight, 6500K cool, filtered down through the canopy as soft top light. Low contrast, no direct sun, no hard shadows. The pale dress is the brightest element in frame and pulls the eye; her face receives soft grey skylight from above. Exposure set for the midtones so the trunks fall to near-black while the moss keeps its green.

COLOR GRADE
Cool, desaturated cyan-teal grade. Premium world-tour footage with natural motion blur, haze, subtle lens breathing, and volumetric beams.

CHARACTER LOCK
The same five adult women, all in their twenties, remain stable.
Leader: long black hair with one violet streak, silver jacket, black top, pleated skirt, knee boots.
Member two: dark ponytail, white asymmetric top, utility shorts.
Member three: silver-blonde hair, graphite bomber, shimmering skirt.
Member four: short black hair, black-and-white top, metal belt.

Hair and fabric move with inertia. Microphones remain in their right hands; choreography accommodates them.

LOCATION AND FORMAT
A vast open-air stadium under a blue-violet sky. The main stage sits at the far center; a T-runway enters the crowd. LED walls show violet nebulae, silver pulses, and white geometry. Spark and flame units line the runway outside the performers’ paths. Fans hold original diamond-shaped violet-white light sticks.

Frame one reveals the stadium, runway, stage, and light ocean. Exactly ten seconds, ten concise shots, with HARD, SMASH, MATCH, and WHIP CUTS. Real-time performance: shorten the actions rather than speeding up the bodies. One camera move per shot. Each shot begins with its action already underway.

Preserve geography, identities, outfits, lighting, smoke, and confetti across cuts. No text, logos, flags, UI, watermarks, or brands.

SHOT 1 — 0.0–0.8 SECONDS
107-degree rectilinear FPV ultra-wide, already diving from above the rear stands toward the distant stage through the crowd light ocean. Show a short segment of the flight, not the entire journey. Light sticks pass with strong parallax; architecture stays straight and twilight remains visible.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 0.8–1.6 SECONDS
84-degree low wide skims a short distance along the runway. All five women already form an arrow, leader half a step forward, members two and three behind her, members four and five at the rear corners. Cold sparks ignite on both sides as they snap their heads up on a musical accent.

Wind carries her violet streak screen-right; sweat, glitter, and earrings catch warm light against violet bokeh. The other four members remain outside this tight crop.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 3.0–4.1 SECONDS
47-degree normal view tracks laterally from front-left, showing all five. They perform one compact original combination: a free-left-arm slice, a shoulder hit, and a grounded crossing step. Boots grip the floor; chains and hair continue moving after the bodies settle.
MATCH CUT on the crossing step.

SHOT 5 — 4.1–4.9 SECONDS
84-degree reverse wide rises slightly behind the group. Continuing the previous movement, all five finish a quarter-turn toward the surrounding audience and lift their microphones outward to invite a response without additional spoken dialogue. A violet-white wave moves through the crowd as searchlights sweep the sky.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 4.9–5.9 SECONDS
107-degree low ultra-wide makes a short orbit from runway-right. Through one visible traveling step each, the group opens into a diamond with the leader at its center and the other four at its points. Paths remain clear; nobody collides, slides, duplicates, or teleports.
SMASH CUT.

SHOT 7 — 5.9–7.0 SECONDS
84-degree frontal full-body view makes a short push from the stage edge. All five perform a sharp free-arm diagonal, one weighted knee dip, then rise into an open star-like group silhouette. Keep all five bodies distinct and fully grounded.
WHIP CUT.

SHOT 8 — 7.0–7.8 SECONDS
47-degree crowd view tilts upward with fans raising violet-white light sticks. Fans chant “Hey! Hey!” on two consecutive beats. The same five performers remain visible dancing on the distant stage. Keep focus on the foreground fans, with the stage recognizable behind them.

SHOT 9 — 7.8–8.7 SECONDS

All five complete one upward free-arm hit as cold sparks fire and a brief flame burst illuminates the stage edges. Violet beams cross through the smoke. Bodies obey gravity, friction, balance, and ground contact. Steady wind drives hair, smoke, sparks, and confetti consistently. Pyrotechnics remain separated from performers and spectators. Exactly five group members in every group shot; no extra performers.

人物固定：
女学生18岁，韩国面孔，长黑直发，藏蓝西装校服外套、白衬衣、黑色丝带领结、灰色格纹裙、白色运动鞋，体型纤细。她不怒吼、不摆胜利姿势，视线始终追踪正在接近的威胁。

三名男子均穿黑色皮夹克，无武器：A短发，快速抓握、近身抢攻；B寸头、体格厚实，连续重拳向前压迫；C长发，从侧后方抓抱。三人身份和人数不变。

左侧旧砖墙前堆着空纸箱，右侧停着两辆踏板车，中间通道可供近身搏斗。受困女子靠左墙，女学生从远处巷口走来。搏斗发生在两名女子之间的通道内。纸箱受到撞击后保留散落状态，踏板车位置不变，倒地男子保留实际落点。

一只高度写实的博美幼犬躲在温馨卧室里柔软的灰色毛毯下面，身下是一张舒适的床，房间充满温暖、柔和的光线。博美幼犬的毛发以纯白色为主，耳朵、额头、脸颊和背部有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发。只有它圆润、蓬松的小脸和一双大大的深棕色眼睛从毛毯下面露出来。
小狗安静地注视着站在手机后面的人。它缓慢眨眼，脑袋轻轻向左、向右歪动。小巧的三角形耳朵微微抖动，胡须自然摆动，小小的黑色鼻子好奇地嗅闻着。
短暂停顿后，小狗慢慢从毛毯下面完全爬出来。它压低身体，摆出准备玩耍扑击的姿势。屁股左右扭动两次，蓬松卷曲的尾巴兴奋地轻轻抽动，瞳孔稍微放大。
毫无预警地，它突然以爆发性的速度直接扑向摄像机。
第一人称视角，摄像机就是观众的手机屏幕。小狗笔直地飞向镜头。即将撞上的一瞬间，它将两只前爪向前伸出，仿佛想要抓住屏幕前的观众。
紧接着——
砰！
小狗一头撞在摄像机前方那块看不见的玻璃上。撞击沉重、有力，并且符合真实物理效果。
它整张蓬松的小脸紧紧贴在玻璃上。小小的黑色鼻子被完全压扁，蓬松的脸颊向两侧挤开，嘴唇被压成滑稽的形状。胡须被玻璃压弯并朝两侧展开，小巧的耳朵因撞击向后压平。
其中一只眼睛被挤得稍微大一些，另一只眼睛则受到轻微压缩。碰撞使它粉红色的小舌头突然从嘴角弹出来，并且意外粘在玻璃上。
两只前爪同时“啪”地拍在玻璃表面，柔软的粉色与黑色小肉垫清晰可见。小狗的表情瞬间从充满自信的顽皮，变成彻底的困惑和茫然。
撞击发生的准确瞬间，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃上出现戏剧性的放射状蜘蛛网裂纹。裂纹以小狗被压扁的鼻子为中心，迅速蔓延至几乎整个屏幕。
玻璃依然保持完整，没有出现破洞，也没有任何玻璃碎片掉落。少量细微的玻璃粉尘短暂漂浮在空中，在温暖的光线下微微闪烁。
小狗保持着整张脸被压在玻璃上的状态大约一秒。它的舌头依然粘在玻璃上，鼻子留下一小块朦胧的雾气鼻印，舌头也留下一点湿润的痕迹。
它的一只眼睛慢慢变成斗鸡眼，并在完全困惑的状态下眨眼两次。嘴巴微微张开，露出十分滑稽的表情。即使脸仍然紧贴着玻璃，两侧蓬松的脸颊还在轻微抖动。
随后，重力开始慢慢将小狗向下拉。
它的脸依然紧贴着布满裂纹的玻璃，并沿着玻璃表面缓慢向下滑动。脸颊在玻璃上拖动，被压扁的鼻子稍微向下拉长。粘在玻璃上的舌头被滑稽地拉长，最后以轻微而富有弹性的动作从玻璃上剥离。
两只前爪也慢慢沿着玻璃向下滑，在玻璃表面留下几个细小的爪印。
小狗逐渐从画面底部消失。
紧接着，短短一瞬之后——
咚！
小狗安全地仰面摔落在摄像机下方。四只爪子全部朝上，蓬松的肚皮完全露出来，粉红色的小舌头依然伸在嘴巴外面。
它的双眼慢慢变成夸张、滑稽的卡通螺旋眼。一只小耳朵轻轻抽动一次，一条后腿不由自主地蹬了一下。蓬松卷曲的尾巴无力地轻轻甩动一次。胸口随着自然呼吸缓慢而轻柔地起伏。
安静躺了一会儿后，其中一只眼睛短暂恢复正常，仿佛它正在努力清醒过来。小狗随后慢慢摇了摇脑袋。
画面无缝渐变回故事开头。小狗再次安静地从毛毯下面探出蓬松的小脸，与第一个镜头完美衔接，形成自然流畅的无限循环。
超写实博美幼犬，毛发以纯白色为主，带有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发区域，整段视频中的毛色分布和外观始终保持一致，极其细腻的蓬松长毛，柔软浓密的双层被毛，自然真实的犬类行为，符合真实物理规律的身体动作，真实可信的面部撞击与玻璃挤压变形，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃裂纹，电影级灯光，温暖的室内氛围，4K HDR，竖屏9:16，浅景深，可爱、滑稽、温馨治愈，适合作为手机动态壁纸，首尾完美无缝循环。

prompts.prompt:
Reference image: use the uploaded image as the character's identity and costume (pale porcelain skin, long platinum-blonde waved hair, jeweled silver tiara, drop earrings and choker, pale blue satin ball gown with silver bead embroidery and multicolored jewels, lace cuffs, pale blue beaded satin heel). Keep her identical in every cut. Refer to her only as the PRINCESS.

15-second cinematic fairy-tale sequence, 20 hard cuts (about 0.75 seconds each), 4:5 vertical, photorealistic, 24fps. A rose garden on a bright sunny day, deep blue cloudless sky, with a giant ornate golden carriage wheel beside her. The PRINCESS stands by the carriage with a cold, regal stare. She lifts her skirt, steps out onto the grass in her glass-like slipper, and walks toward the camera with quiet, imperious confidence. Strong midday sunlight, saturated colors, crisp shadows, light breeze moving her hair and skirt. Consistent location, lighting and wardrobe across all cuts. Fast, rhythmic editing with one smooth continuous action across the cuts.

Cuts:
1. (0.00-0.75s) Extreme low-angle wide shot, ultra-wide lens: the PRINCESS towers over the camera beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky behind her.
2. (0.75-1.50s) Wide shot, eye level: the PRINCESS stands still among the rose bushes, breeze lifting her hair.
3. (1.50-2.25s) Medium shot, front: her chin lifts slightly, a cold, unimpressed expression.
4. (2.25-3.00s) Extreme close-up, front: her eyes, pale lashes, and the sparkle of her tiara above.
5. (3.00-3.75s) Close-up, side profile: the jeweled drop earring and choker catch the sun.
6. (3.75-4.50s) Extreme close-up, macro: her fingers gather the satin skirt, jewels and beadwork glittering.
7. (4.50-5.25s) Low angle, looking up: she raises the hem, the huge embroidered skirt filling the frame.
8. (5.25-6.00s) Ground-level shot in the grass: her beaded pale blue slipper lifts and steps forward, grass blades bending.
9. (6.00-6.75s) Detail shot, slightly low: the slipper presses into the grass, sunlight sparkling on the pearls.
10. (6.75-7.50s) Side tracking shot, medium: the PRINCESS walks away from the carriage, the golden wheel sliding past behind her.
11. (7.50-8.25s) Dutch angle, medium wide: she walks, the rose hedges and sky tilted behind her.
12. (8.25-9.00s) Rear tracking shot: her long waved hair and the embroidered back of the gown, following her through the garden.
13. (9.00-9.75s) High angle, top-down: the skirt sweeping across the green lawn, jeweled hem glittering.
14. (9.75-10.50s) Front tracking shot, backing away: she walks toward the camera with an imperious stare.
15. (10.50-11.25s) Close-up, three-quarter angle: her face in hard sunlight, the tiara glinting, expression unmoved.
16. (11.25-12.00s) Low angle, wide: the PRINCESS silhouetted against the deep blue sky, skirt billowing in the breeze.
17. (12.00-12.75s) Medium shot, side: she stops and slowly turns her head toward the camera.
18. (12.75-13.50s) Slow push-in, close-up front: a faint, cold, knowing smile.
19. (13.50-14.25s) Orbit shot, medium: the camera arcs around her, the golden wheel and roses sweeping past behind.
20. (14.25-15.00s) Final extreme low-angle wide shot, slow pull-back: the PRINCESS standing tall in the grass beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky above, holding the pose.

Style: 35mm film photography look, saturated Kodak-style color, deep blue sky, crisp natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, realistic skin texture, realistic satin, lace, bead and jewel detail, realistic hair and cloth physics. Sound: soft breeze, distant birds, rustling grass and satin, light magical chimes building gently toward the end. No dialogue, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

prompts.prompt:
プロンプト全文です（Higgsfield／Seedance 2.5、480p→1080pアップスケール。参照画像はキャラシートと屋上の背景シートの2枚）

[image1] is the exact reference for the main character: an adult Japanese woman in her mid-20s. [image2] is the rooftop location from every side. Never show any reference as a sheet, collage, or split-screen.

CHARACTER LOCK:
Keep her exactly as in [image1] throughout: same face, same dark brown short bob with see-through bangs, same white knee-length chiffon dress: the puff sleeves are sheer and airy, while the bodice and skirt have an opaque white lining, same white strap shoes. She holds a pale pink smartphone in her RIGHT hand, raised high above her face at arm's length, angled down at her for a classic high-angle selfie. The camera only ever sees the plain pink back of the phone; the phone screen is never shown.
Her mood is natural and sweet: a warm, gentle smile and a soft, clear, cheerful voice, neither loud nor whispery.
She is the only person in white and the only woman with a short dark bob. No guest looks like her.

PARTY GUESTS AND POSITIONS:
About ten adult guests in deep red, emerald, navy and gold evening clothes, all with different faces and hairstyles. They never look at the camera and never interact with her. Everyone, including her, stands on the rooftop floor on the same side of the railing. She stands in the open middle of the rooftop; the guests are around and behind her; the railing with bulbs and the skyline are at the far back. Nobody stands beyond the railing.
- Just to her left: a man and a woman at a small high table, clinking champagne glasses.
- Just behind her right shoulder: a waiter carrying a tray of glasses.

STYLE:
Photorealistic, dreamy night film. Warm bulb light, cool blue night sky, soft city bokeh. 9:16 vertical.
ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT WITH NO CUTS. The camera always stays level and upright; it never rolls or turns upside down. She stays in the frame the whole time.
No text, no signs, no logos, no subtitles anywhere.

LOCATION:
The rooftop in [image2] during a party: stone tiles, black railing with round warm bulbs, wooden planters, small high tables, the night skyline, and on the opposite side the small stairwell building with a plain door. A breeze blows a stream of soap bubbles and gold confetti past her and past the lens.

MOTION STRUCTURE (15s):

[0s-4.5s] SELFIE AT THE PARTY
First frame: medium-full shot from the front, she is already smiling with her hair moving in the breeze, bubbles streaming past, the party in full motion around her: the couple clinking glasses, the waiter walking past with his tray, guests dancing and laughing, a confetti cannon firing a gold burst. She looks around at the party, then lifts the phone high above her face in her right hand; the camera glides in to her face as she smiles up at the phone and says 「いくよ」.
Audio: light party pop music, chatter, breeze, her voice.

[4.5s] THE CLICK
She presses the shutter, smiling up at the phone with both eyes open (no wink yet). On the click, time stops completely: hair frozen mid-sway, every bubble and confetti piece frozen mid-flight, one small bubble just beside her left cheek, never in front of her face, frozen in the instant of bursting in a hanging spray of tiny droplets, the champagne frozen mid-splash between the couple's glasses, the waiter frozen mid-stride with a glass tipping off his tray, the dancers frozen mid-turn.
Audio: the click, then the music and every sound cut out at once.

[4.5s-8s] THE ORBIT
Nothing moves except the camera. It pulls back to medium-full distance and travels one full 360-degree circle around her, keeping her in the center of the frame, with a clear change of speed: it starts slowly while still in front of her so her frozen smile is clearly seen, accelerates hard as it swings around behind her, whipping past the frozen champagne splash, the waiter's tipping glass and the frozen guests, then slows down smoothly as it comes back around to her front.
Audio: near silence, only an airy camera whoosh that rises with the speed behind her and fades as it slows.

[8s-10.5s] ONLY ME
The camera glides in to a close-up of her face. Everything stays frozen. Only she moves: her eyes slide from the phone to the lens, she raises the index finger of her LEFT hand to her lips, "shh".
Audio: complete silence, then her soft "shh".

[10.5s-11s] THE WINK
Still in close-up, she gives one playful one-eyed wink: only her right eye closes while her left eye stays open, and on that wink the frozen bubble beside her cheek pops and time snaps back: bubbles and confetti fly on, the champagne splashes into the glasses, the waiter catches the glass, her hair sways.
Audio: the bubble pop on her wink, then the music and party sound drop back in on the beat.

[11s-15s] BACK TO THE START
The party is in full motion again. The camera glides back out to the same medium-full front framing as the very first frame. She giggles, glances around at the party as if nothing happened, and lifts the phone high again for another selfie, so the last frame matches the first frame for a seamless loop.
Audio: the music and party sound play on; her light giggle.

FROZEN-TIME RULE:
While time is frozen (4.5s-10.5s), nothing moves except the camera and, only from 8s to 10.5s, the woman in white. Every guest stays perfectly still: no blinking, no breathing, no drifting liquid. No new objects or people appear.

NOTES:
Start with strong motion on the very first frame so the freeze is obvious.
She is the only main character; the guests never become her double.
She is clearly an adult; the framing is respectful and never aims at her chest or under the dress.
Her outfit, hair and phone stay identical throughout. No bubble ever covers her face.
She says only 「いくよ」 and "shh". No text, no logos, no watermarks.
