prompts.prompt:
15 SECOND CINEMATIC VIDEO
ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT, FOLLOWED BY A FINAL CUT TO BLACK.
16:9. Natural sound. No dialogue. No music.

REFERENCES
Use @image1 as the starting composition.
Preserve the black umbrella, upright shaft, round weighted base, room, furniture, window light and patterned tiles.

CONTINUITY RULES
The umbrella remains open and completely stationary.
Rain originates from the underside of the canopy.
Drops fall vertically onto the tiles directly beneath it.
Keep falling water and tiny splashes inside the canopy's footprint.
The rest of the room remains dry.
Existing floor reflections belong to dry ceramic.
Only the area beneath the umbrella gradually becomes wet.

SCENE STATE
Begin as shown in @Image1:
An empty Jakarta room in natural daylight.
One open black umbrella on its weighted stand.
The floor is completely dry.
No falling water or puddle at the start.

TIMESTAMPED SHOT BREAKDOWN
00–03 SECONDS
Hold the still room.
After a brief dry opening, a few droplets begin falling from the underside of the canopy near the shaft.
Each drop falls visibly through the air before striking the tiles.

03–08 SECONDS
The droplets develop into a gentle localized shower beneath the umbrella.
Show clear falling drops and tiny splashes against ceramic.
The canopy's upper surface stays dry.
No rain above the umbrella or elsewhere in the room.

08–12 SECONDS
The tiles directly beneath the umbrella become progressively wet.
A shallow puddle forms around the weighted base.
Its boundary grows continuously from individual impacts.
Small ripples spread across the accumulating water.
The wet tiles gain subtle reflections of the window and umbrella.

12–14.5 SECONDS
Hold on the continuing shower and visibly wet floor.
Clearly show the shallow puddle, droplet impacts and reflective ceramic beneath the umbrella.
Maintain a readable boundary between the wet patch and surrounding dry tiles.
The puddle stays within the canopy's footprint.
No further escalation or flooding.

14.5–15 SECONDS
CUT TO BLACK.
Immediate hard cut to a completely black frame.
The rain sound stops at the cut.
Hold black and silence until the video ends.
No fade or end title.

CAMERA
ARRI ALEXA 35 aesthetic, 35mm lens.
Match @Image1's framing and perspective.
Locked tripod throughout the room shot.
Enough depth of field to keep the umbrella, falling droplets and wet tiles readable.
No pan, tilt, zoom, tracking or focus changes.
The final cut to black is the only edit.

PERFORMANCE
No people.
The umbrella, stand and furniture remain still.
Only falling water, tiny splashes and puddle ripples move.

NATIVE AUDIO
Quiet indoor room tone.
Sparse droplets striking dry ceramic at first.
The sound gradually becomes gentle rain splashing into shallow water.
Keep the sound localized and intimate.
No thunder, dialogue, voice over, score or music.
All audio ends with the final cut to black.

VISUAL STYLE
Photorealistic cinematic image.
Preserve the reference's natural daylight, muted colors and worn materials.
Realistic gravity, transparent water and natural reflections.
Subtle film grain and restrained contrast.
The impossible event feels physically present.
No magical light or stylized effects.

NEGATIVE DIRECTION
No rain throughout the room, ceiling leaks or outdoor rainfall.
No water passing through the canopy from above.
No moving umbrella, changing furniture or altered tile pattern.
No instant puddle, flooding, large splashes or wet areas becoming dry again.
No lens splashes or water outside the canopy's footprint.
No people, camera movement or cuts during the room shot.
Only the explicitly requested final CUT TO BLACK is permitted.
No dissolve, fade, text, subtitles, logos or music

prompts.prompt: "Cinematic live-action Korean action-comedy short, 16:9, realistic photographic look, bright natural daylight pouring through tall school-corridor windows, soft pastel sage-green and cream walls, pale blue classroom doors, polished grey floor with glossy reflections, slight film grain, smooth stabilized camera with quick punch-in cuts. **Main character:** A elegant Korean female teacher with a sleek black low bun, thin round gold-rimmed glasses, small pearl earrings, champagne satin sleeveless blouse, black leather pencil skirt, black sheer tights, black stiletto heels, carrying a navy hardcover book. ​Basic Settings
​Duration: 30-second short
​Genre: Fast-paced exhilarating anime film, Makoto Shinkai style
​Setting: The beautifully ruined Itsukushima Shrine. The iconic massive vermilion Grand Torii gate and traditional wooden kairo (corridors) are partially submerged in crystal-clear glowing ocean water. The architecture is elegantly decaying, heavily overgrown with lush, vibrant green moss, vines, and luminous flora under a bright blue sky with towering cumulonimbus clouds.
​Style & Visuals
​Quality: Premium cinematic anime, breathtaking highly detailed backgrounds, vibrant vivid color palette.
​Lighting: Emotional summer sunlight, cinematic volumetric light rays, brilliant lens flares.
​Camera & Framing: Exhilarating high-speed camera work, dynamic motion blur. A mix of fast tracking shots and static fixed-camera pass-by shots to emphasize speed.
​Animation/Physics: Extreme sense of speed, aggressive water splashing, dynamic wind blowing through hair and clothes.
​Consistency: Strictly maintain absolute visual consistency for the characters, lighting, and environment from start to finish.
​Audio & ASMR
​BGM: Fast-paced, uplifting, and exhilarating cinematic instrumental music.
​SFX: Intense water splashing, rhythmic running footsteps on wet wood, dynamic wind whooshes as they pass the camera, soft happy dog panting.
​Voice: Absolutely NO dialogue, NO voices.
​Characters
​Character 1 (Nako): A cute, energetic young girl with lively short hair, wearing active travel gear (lightweight explorer jacket, sturdy boots, backpack).
​Character 2 (Toto): A cute Shih Tzu dog acting as her partner. Fluffy white fur with light tan/golden patches on his ears and face.
​Condition: Maintain strong visual character consistency for both Nako and Toto throughout the entire video.
​Timeline & Action
​0–7s: Fast-paced tracking shot from behind. Nako and Toto sprint at top speed across the shallow, crystal-clear water towards the giant vermilion Torii gate in the distance. Intense water splashes up, sparkling in the vibrant sunlight.
​7–14s: Static low-angle camera (fixed shot). Nako and Toto zip past the lens at incredibly high speed, creating a dynamic motion blur and a strong gust of wind. They race along the ruined, moss-covered wooden kairo (corridors).
​14–22s: Exhilarating 360-degree high-speed orbit tracking shot. They seamlessly leap over ancient, overgrown tree roots breaking through the shrine's wooden floor. Toto happily bounds through the air. Brilliant light rays pierce through the ruined roof.
​22–30s: Dynamic drone-like pull-back shot. They finally reach the base of the massive Torii gate and skid to a halt, looking out at the glowing horizon. The camera sweeps up into the bright blue sky, revealing a breathtaking wide shot of the vibrant ruined Itsukushima Shrine.
​Negative Prompt / Constraints
​No dialogue, no text, no subtitles, no UI.
​No dark, gloomy, or scary elements.
​No visual inconsistencies, no flickering, no character morphing.

25.0s HARD CUT

SCENE DIRECTION (shared, unspoken): stay the professional, verify before reacting.
MOTIVE (his fuel): if this is real, the one who notices it calmly is the one who survives it.
GOAL: prove to himself it is a glitch, a loop, a recording, anything but live.

Photoreal paranoid political-thriller look, grounded and procedural, 2.39:1 widescreen, fine organic digital grain, crisp center sharpness with soft edges.

2.39:1, 24 fps real-time throughout. 8K detail intent.

@Image 1's face, hair and black polo stay identical in every shot and in the CCTV feed. Face shots stay centered with the dark monitor edge filling the lower 30% of frame. Performance：喷气时眼睛半眯，眉头收紧，用力集中在胸口和下颌。
Constraints：喷出的是白色冷气，不是水柱、火焰或激光；冷气只从嘴里出来，手不放出任何东西；林澈不碰墙面；冰霜只覆盖起火的几层；离开时必须飞出画面，不原地消失。

SHOT 5（9.0–10.2秒）｜失控公交冲下坡
Subject：失控公交车、司机、林澈（远处小人影）
Action：一辆白色车身、蓝色腰线的城市公交车从坡上向镜头高速冲下，车头左前角撞倒一串交通锥，交通锥向两侧弹开滚动。驾驶座里的司机双手紧抓方向盘，身体后仰，右腿用力踩踏板但车速不减。9.6秒起，林澈从画面左上方天空出现，身体水平，斜向下朝路口俯冲。
Environment：坡道上的私家车停在红灯后不动；交通锥在柏油路上弹跳翻滚。
Camera：24mm广角，机位贴近路面，位于斑马线上，略带10度倾斜，固定。
Style：正午硬光，公交车在路面投下清晰阴影。
Performance：司机面部惊慌，嘴张开。
Constraints：公交车四轮着地，不翻车、不侧倾超过5度；线路屏和车牌不出现可读文字；只有一辆公交车。

SHOT 6（10.2–14.0秒）｜落地奔跑、双手顶停公交
Subject：林澈、公交车
Action：
10.2–10.6秒：林澈从画面左上方掠过镜头左侧，在镜头前方约3米处落地，背对镜头，膝盖弯曲缓冲，身体前倾不停顿，披风顺势下落摆动。
10.6–11.2秒：林澈向公交车跑三步，双臂向前伸出。
11.2–13.0秒：林澈双手掌心贴在车头挡风玻璃下方的前脸面板上，双手与肩同宽，双腿前后大分开，前腿弯曲，后腿伸直，后脚鞋底蹬住路面。公交车推着林澈继续向前，林澈鞋底在路面上向后滑动约1米，扬起一层灰尘。林澈肩背绷紧，身体前倾约45度，公交车车速降为零，在斑马线前停住，车头向下点一下再回弹，披风与身体惯性向后拉扯。
13.0–14.0秒：林澈双手离开车头，双膝下蹲，双脚蹬地，垂直向上飞起，从车头上方飞出画面上沿。
Environment：被撞倒的交通锥散落在公交车两侧；灰尘向两侧散开。
Camera：35mm，机位在林澈身后约6米、低于腰部高度，固定，公交车车头正对镜头居中。
Style：林澈的影子投在斑马线上。
Performance：只拍背影，用肩膀、手臂和腿部绷紧表现用力。
Constraints：只用双手掌心推车头，不用肩撞、不用头顶；公交车不压过林澈；双手不穿进车身；公交车停下后不再移动。

SHOT 7（14.0–15.0秒）｜工地钢梁失控摆动
Subject：吊装钢梁、三名工人
Action：锈色工字钢梁挂在黄色吊钩下，一条米黄色吊装带兜住梁的中部，钢梁在空中向画右大幅摆动并快速下降，一端向下倾斜。楼板上三名穿荧光黄反光背心、戴白色安全帽的工人抬头看见后，转身向画面左右两侧奔跑躲避。
Environment：楼板上散放木料和橙白条纹路障。
Camera：18mm超广角，机位贴近楼板向上仰拍，固定。
Style：蓝天背景，钢结构线条清晰。
Performance：工人表情惊恐，边跑边回头看。
Constraints：吊装带不断裂，钢梁始终挂在吊钩下；工人不被砸中；钢梁只有一根。

SHOT 8（15.0–17.5秒）｜从天而降，双手托住钢梁
Subject：林澈、钢梁
Action：
15.0–15.6秒：林澈身体竖直、双脚朝下，从画面上方垂直落下，落在钢梁正下方楼板中央，双膝弯曲缓冲，披风向上翻后再落下。
15.6–16.3秒：钢梁摆向林澈，林澈双手举过头顶，掌心朝上托住钢梁下翼缘，双手间距约1.2米；钢梁压下时林澈膝盖再弯曲约10厘米，然后蹬直。
16.3–17.5秒：钢梁停止摆动，在林澈头顶水平静止。吊装带垂在林澈身体右侧，不挡脸。林澈抬头看一眼吊钩。
Environment：工人已跑到画面两侧边缘停下回头看。
Camera：24mm低机位仰拍，机位在林澈正前方约5米，16.0秒钢梁压下时镜头轻微震动一下。
Style：林澈的脸在钢梁下方阴影里，逆光勾出头发边缘。
Performance：接住时咬紧牙关，稳定后表情放松。
Constraints：只用双手掌心托住，不用头和肩扛；钢梁不穿过身体和手；吊装带和吊钩不与林澈身体融合。

SHOT 9（17.5–20.0秒）｜放下钢梁、摘钩、起飞
Subject：林澈、钢梁
Action：
17.5–18.3秒：林澈托着钢梁弯腰屈膝向下放，把钢梁水平放在镜头前方楼板上两根平行的地面钢梁上，落稳时扬起一层灰。
18.3–19.2秒：林澈半蹲在钢梁后，只露出上半身，右手取下吊装带向上一松，吊装带和黄色吊钩空着垂在林澈右侧。
19.2–20.0秒：林澈站直，下蹲蹬地，垂直向上飞起，双腿从画面上沿飞出，画面只留钢梁、吊钩和钢结构。
Environment：灰尘慢慢落回楼板。
Camera：24mm低机位，钢梁在画面最下方前景横贯整个画面，固定。
Style：前景钢梁锈迹清晰。
Performance：神情轻松，不看镜头。
Constraints：飞走时手里不拿吊装带和吊钩；钢梁放下后不再移动。

SHOT 10（20.0–21.6秒）｜快艇撞浪，一人落水
Subject：快艇、乘客、落水男子、林澈（远处小人影）
Action：一艘白色船身、黑色遮阳顶棚的敞篷快艇从画左向画右冲上一道绿色浪头，船头高高翘起，船身向右倾斜约20度，船上五名乘客抓紧扶手。20.7秒船头砸回水面，船尾一名穿蓝色短袖T恤、卡其色短裤、光脚的成年男子被甩出右舷，背朝下掉进海里。21.0秒林澈从画面左上方天空水平高速飞来，21.4秒头朝下扎进男子落水处旁边的海面，溅起白色水花。
Environment：浪头透光呈绿色，船尾激起白色浪花。
Camera：28mm，机位贴近水面，跟随快艇向右平移。
Style：下午斜光，海面反光强烈。
Performance：乘客张嘴惊叫，伸手指向落水处。
Constraints：快艇不翻船；只有一个人落水；落水过程必须完整拍到。

SHOT 11（21.6–23.4秒）｜水下抱住落水男子
Subject：林澈、落水男子
Action：
21.6–22.3秒：水下，男子在快艇船底下方缓慢下沉，双臂无力漂起，眼睛闭着，嘴里冒出一串气泡。林澈从画左游入，双臂向前伸直，双腿并拢，直线快速前进，披风与头发在水中漂动。
22.3–22.9秒：林澈双臂从正面环抱住男子上身，男子的头靠在林澈右肩上。
22.9–23.4秒：林澈抱着男子转向上方，双腿向下一蹬，两人向水面快速冲去，身后留下一串气泡。
Environment：浑浊的蓝绿色海水，阳光从水面透下形成光柱，快艇船底在画面上方是一大块深色阴影。
Camera：35mm水下摄影，固定机位，与两人同深度。
Style：衣服、披风和头发湿透贴身，随水流飘动。
Performance：林澈眼睛睁开，嘴闭紧。
Constraints：林澈不撞上船底；被救男子服装保持不变。

SHOT 12（23.4–26.0秒）｜破水飞上沙滩，交给救生员
Subject：林澈、落水男子、三名救生员
Action：
23.4–24.3秒：林澈从近岸浪花里冲出水面，双臂紧抱男子腰背，男子双臂搭在林澈肩上，两人身体竖直，离水面约1米，斜向画右沙滩飞去，身后拖出一大片白色水花，身上的水不断滴落，披风完全湿透并向后拖曳。
24.3–25.3秒：三名穿红橙色救生制服、戴红色头盔的救生员从画右沙滩跑来。林澈在湿沙上方降低高度，把男子双脚放到沙地上，两名救生员把男子左右手臂搭到自己肩上撑住，第三名扶住男子后背。
25.3–26.0秒：林澈松开双手，向画面左上方斜向飞起，飞出画面上沿。
Environment：海浪冲上沙滩，湿沙反光，远处有棕榈树和海边建筑。
Camera：35mm，机位贴近沙滩低位，从水边向画右横移跟拍，然后停住拍交接。
Style：下午阳光，水珠在逆光中发亮。
Performance：男子虚弱地咳嗽，头低垂但能站住；救生员神情专注。
Constraints：几个人的手臂不穿插融合；林澈不把男子扔出去；三名救生员服装统一。

SHOT 13（26.0–30.0秒）｜黄昏空中散步，发现下一个紧急情况
Subject：林澈、红色流星
Action：
26.0–28.0秒：日落时分，林澈在海岸线上空约150米处朝镜头方向步行，脚下没有任何东西。双腿交替迈步，双臂自然前后摆动，肩膀放松，头向左右转动看下方的海岸和城市，披风自然垂落并轻微摆动。
28.0–28.6秒：画面左上方天空，一颗带短尾迹的红色流星斜向下划过。林澈转头看向流星，眉毛抬起，脚步停下。
28.6–30.0秒：林澈上身向前倾倒变成水平，双臂收在身体两侧，朝镜头高速冲来，1秒内从全身变成脸部充满画面，从镜头左侧擦过飞出画面，最后画面只剩空的海岸线和红色流星。
Environment：画左是亮起灯光的海边城市，画右是金色反光的大海，远山呈淡紫色。
Camera：无人机航拍，35mm，机位在林澈前方同高度向后倒飞，速度与林澈步行速度相同，林澈保持在画面中央。
Style：日落金橙色逆光，脸部被暖色反光照亮，头发边缘有金色轮廓光。
Performance：前段表情放松，嘴角微微上扬；看到流星时表情一紧，嘴唇抿住。
Constraints：脚下不出现地面、栏杆或透明平台；流星只有一颗且不爆炸；林澈冲出画面后不再回来；最后画面不出现文字。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NEGATIVE / 全片负面约束：
慢动作、子弹时间、定格；换装；第二个主角；眼睛发光；手掌放出能量光；可读的文字、线路屏字样、车牌号、船名、Logo、水印、字幕；威亚绳、绿幕、支架；人物凭空出现或凭空消失；公交车翻车、快艇翻覆、多人落水、爆炸；吊装带缠绕在人身上；钢梁弯曲变形；出水后衣服和披风是干的；肢体穿插、多出手指；身体比例变形；塑料CG质感；镜头剧烈乱晃；角色脸部漂移；发型变化；服装变化；披风消失；战衣变成其他款式；靴子变化；角色突然变成其他女性。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic 16:9 1080p live-action video filmed like casual handheld footage by a friend using an older digital camera.

A young French woman in her early 20s, with long naturally loose dark-brown hair, wears a dark green knit sweater, black wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, and carries a small burgundy handbag. Keep her face, identity, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and handbag identical throughout.

LOCATION: A small independent movie theater in Lyon, France, around 8:30 PM. The theater is almost completely empty. Red fabric seats, dark carpet, narrow aisles, dim wall lights, small ticket counter, fictional movie posters, projector-room window, and a quiet lobby. Use only fictional movie titles and posters.

CAMERA: Raw handheld consumer-camera footage. Slight natural shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure adjustment, mild digital noise, natural motion blur and compression. No stabilization, cinematic bokeh, professional lighting, smooth tracking, or commercial/trailer aesthetic.

0-5s , EMPTY LOBBY  
Camera follows her through the nearly empty lobby. She looks around and quietly says, “We're really early.” She smiles and enters the screening room.

5-10s , FINDING A SEAT  
She walks down the aisle and chooses a middle seat. She sits naturally, compressing the fabric seat, and places her burgundy handbag beside her.

10-15s , PROJECTOR  
She looks toward the screen. A realistic projector beam cuts through the darkness, with dust visible only inside the beam. She looks at the camera and whispers, “Look at that.” Camera tilts slightly toward the projector.

15-20s , POPCORN  
She notices a half-empty popcorn bucket on a nearby empty seat. She picks it up, looks confused, and says, “Someone forgot this.” She places it on the floor beside the seat.

20-25s , LIGHTS DIM  
The theater lights suddenly become darker. The projector becomes brighter and softly illuminates her face. She looks around briefly, then settles into her seat.

25-30s , QUIET MOMENT  
Camera stays behind her shoulder as she watches the screen. Only soft fictional screen light illuminates her face. She briefly turns and smiles at the camera. Autofocus becomes slightly soft as the camera moves, then the video ends naturally.

AUDIO: Natural theater ambience only,quiet footsteps, carpet movement, seat sounds, fabric movement, distant lobby sounds, projector fan, electrical hum, room echo, and quiet whispers. NO background music. Movie audio must be indistinct and completely original.

REALISM: Physically accurate projector light, dust, shadows, seat compression, handbag deformation, hair and clothing movement, and screen illumination. No recognizable movie footage or dialogue.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: CGI, animation, 3D render, plastic skin, beauty filter, face morphing, identity drift, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated people, floating objects, impossible lighting, fake projector beam, excessive HDR, oversaturation, artificial bokeh, cinematic trailer look, perfect stabilization, exaggerated acting, horror effects, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, continuity errors, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, real movie posters, copyrighted footage, copyrighted dialogue, copyrighted music.

FINAL STYLE: Quiet, ordinary, slightly nostalgic, intimate, imperfect, and genuinely believable,like a friend casually recording an almost-empty cinema before a movie starts.
